2199#endif /* CONFIG_MEMORY_ISOLATION */
2200
2201static inline bool boost_watermark(struct zone *zone)
2202{
2203 unsigned long max_boost;
2204
2205 if (!watermark_boost_factor)
2206 return false;
2207 /*
2208 * Don't bother in zones that are unlikely to produce results.
2209 * On small machines, including kdump capture kernels running
2210 * in a small area, boosting the watermark can cause an out of
2211 * memory situation immediately.
2212 */
2213 if ((pageblock_nr_pages * 4) > zone_managed_pages(zone))
2214 return false;
2215
2216 max_boost = mult_frac(zone->_watermark[WMARK_HIGH],
2217 watermark_boost_factor, 10000);
2218
2219 /*
2220 * high watermark may be uninitialised if fragmentation occurs
2221 * very early in boot so do not boost. We do not fall
2222 * through and boost by pageblock_nr_pages as failing
2223 * allocations that early means that reclaim is not going
2224 * to help and it may even be impossible to reclaim the
2225 * boosted watermark resulting in a hang.
2226 */
2227 if (!max_boost)
2228 return false;
2229
2230 max_boost = max(pageblock_nr_pages, max_boost);
2231
2232 zone->watermark_boost = min(zone->watermark_boost + pageblock_nr_pages,
2233 max_boost);
2234
2235 return true;
2236}
2237
2238/*
2239 * When we are falling back to another migratetype during allocation, should we
2240 * try to claim an entire block to satisfy further allocations, instead of
2241 * polluting multiple pageblocks?
2242 */
2243static bool should_try_claim_block(unsigned int order, int start_mt)
2244{
2245 /*
2246 * Leaving this order check is intended, although there is
2247 * relaxed order check in next check. The reason is that
2248 * we can actually claim the whole pageblock if this condition met,
2249 * but, below check doesn't guarantee it and that is just heuristic
2250 * so could be changed anytime.
2251 */
2252 if (order >= pageblock_order)
2253 return true;
2254
2255 /*
2256 * Above a certain threshold, always try to claim, as it's likely there
2257 * will be more free pages in the pageblock.
2258 */
2259 if (order >= pageblock_order / 2)
2260 return true;
2261
2262 /*
2263 * Unmovable/reclaimable allocations would cause permanent
2264 * fragmentations if they fell back to allocating from a movable block
2265 * (polluting it), so we try to claim the whole block regardless of the
2266 * allocation size. Later movable allocations can always steal from this
2267 * block, which is less problematic.
2268 */
2269 if (start_mt == MIGRATE_RECLAIMABLE || start_mt == MIGRATE_UNMOVABLE)
2270 return true;
2271
2272 if (page_group_by_mobility_disabled)
2273 return true;
2274
2275 /*
2276 * Movable pages won't cause permanent fragmentation, so when you alloc
2277 * small pages, we just need to temporarily steal unmovable or
2278 * reclaimable pages that are closest to the request size. After a
2279 * while, memory compaction may occur to form large contiguous pages,
2280 * and the next movable allocation may not need to steal.
2281 */
2282 return false;
2283}
2284
2285/*
2286 * Check whether there is a suitable fallback freepage with requested order.
2287 * If claimable is true, this function returns fallback_mt only if
2288 * we would do this whole-block claiming. This would help to reduce
2289 * fragmentation due to mixed migratetype pages in one pageblock.
2290 */
2291int find_suitable_fallback(struct free_area *area, unsigned int order,
2292 int migratetype, bool claimable)
2293{
2294 int i;
2295
2296 if (claimable && !should_try_claim_block(order, migratetype))
2297 return -2;
2298
2299 if (area->nr_free == 0)
2300 return -1;
2301
2302 for (i = 0; i < MIGRATE_PCPTYPES - 1 ; i++) {
2303 int fallback_mt = fallbacks[migratetype][i];
2304
2305 if (!free_area_empty(area, fallback_mt))
2306 return fallback_mt;
2307 }
2308
2309 return -1;
2310}
2311
2312/*
2313 * This function implements actual block claiming behaviour. If order is large
2314 * enough, we can claim the whole pageblock for the requested migratetype. If
2315 * not, we check the pageblock for constituent pages; if at least half of the
2316 * pages are free or compatible, we can still claim the whole block, so pages
2317 * freed in the future will be put on the correct free list.
2318 */
2319static struct page *
2320try_to_claim_block(struct zone *zone, struct page *page,
2321 int current_order, int order, int start_type,
2322 int block_type, unsigned int alloc_flags)
2323{
2324 int free_pages, movable_pages, alike_pages;
2325 unsigned long start_pfn;
2326
2327 /* Take ownership for orders >= pageblock_order */
2328 if (current_order >= pageblock_order) {
2329 unsigned int nr_added;
2330
2331 del_page_from_free_list(page, zone, current_order, block_type);
2332 change_pageblock_range(page, current_order, start_type);
2333 nr_added = expand(zone, page, order, current_order, start_type);
2334 account_freepages(zone, nr_added, start_type);
2335 return page;
2336 }
2337
2338 /*
2339 * Boost watermarks to increase reclaim pressure to reduce the
2340 * likelihood of future fallbacks. Wake kswapd now as the node
2341 * may be balanced overall and kswapd will not wake naturally.
2342 */
2343 if (boost_watermark(zone) && (alloc_flags & ALLOC_KSWAPD))
2344 set_bit(ZONE_BOOSTED_WATERMARK, &zone->flags);
2345
2346 /* moving whole block can fail due to zone boundary conditions */
2347 if (!prep_move_freepages_block(zone, page, &start_pfn, &free_pages,
2348 &movable_pages))
2349 return NULL;
2350
2351 /*
2352 * Determine how many pages are compatible with our allocation.
2353 * For movable allocation, it's the number of movable pages which
2354 * we just obtained. For other types it's a bit more tricky.
2355 */
2356 if (start_type == MIGRATE_MOVABLE) {
2357 alike_pages = movable_pages;
2358 } else {
2359 /*
2360 * If we are falling back a RECLAIMABLE or UNMOVABLE allocation
2361 * to MOVABLE pageblock, consider all non-movable pages as
2362 * compatible. If it's UNMOVABLE falling back to RECLAIMABLE or
2363 * vice versa, be conservative since we can't distinguish the
2364 * exact migratetype of non-movable pages.
2365 */
2366 if (block_type == MIGRATE_MOVABLE)
2367 alike_pages = pageblock_nr_pages
2368 - (free_pages + movable_pages);
2369 else
2370 alike_pages = 0;
2371 }
2372 /*
2373 * If a sufficient number of pages in the block are either free or of
2374 * compatible migratability as our allocation, claim the whole block.
2375 */
2376 if (free_pages + alike_pages >= (1 << (pageblock_order-1)) ||
2377 page_group_by_mobility_disabled) {
2378 __move_freepages_block(zone, start_pfn, block_type, start_type);
2379 set_pageblock_migratetype(pfn_to_page(start_pfn), start_type);
2380 return __rmqueue_smallest(zone, order, start_type);
2381 }
2382
2383 return NULL;
2384}
2385
2386/*
2387 * Try to allocate from some fallback migratetype by claiming the entire block,
2388 * i.e. converting it to the allocation's start migratetype.
2389 *
2390 * The use of signed ints for order and current_order is a deliberate
2391 * deviation from the rest of this file, to make the for loop
2392 * condition simpler.
2393 */
2394static __always_inline struct page *
2395__rmqueue_claim(struct zone *zone, int order, int start_migratetype,
2396 unsigned int alloc_flags)
2397{
2398 struct free_area *area;
2399 int current_order;
2400 int min_order = order;
2401 struct page *page;
2402 int fallback_mt;
2403
2404 /*
2405 * Do not steal pages from freelists belonging to other pageblocks
2406 * i.e. orders < pageblock_order. If there are no local zones free,
2407 * the zonelists will be reiterated without ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT.
2408 */
2409 if (order < pageblock_order && alloc_flags & ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT)
2410 min_order = pageblock_order;
2411
2412 /*
2413 * Find the largest available free page in the other list. This roughly
2414 * approximates finding the pageblock with the most free pages, which
2415 * would be too costly to do exactly.
2416 */
2417 for (current_order = MAX_PAGE_ORDER; current_order >= min_order;
2418 --current_order) {
2419 area = &(zone->free_area[current_order]);
2420 fallback_mt = find_suitable_fallback(area, current_order,
2421 start_migratetype, true);
2422
2423 /* No block in that order */
2424 if (fallback_mt == -1)
2425 continue;
2426
2427 /* Advanced into orders too low to claim, abort */
2428 if (fallback_mt == -2)
2429 break;
2430
2431 page = get_page_from_free_area(area, fallback_mt);
2432 page = try_to_claim_block(zone, page, current_order, order,
2433 start_migratetype, fallback_mt,
2434 alloc_flags);
2435 if (page) {
2436 trace_mm_page_alloc_extfrag(page, order, current_order,
2437 start_migratetype, fallback_mt);
2438 return page;
2439 }
2440 }
2441
2442 return NULL;
2443}
2444
2445/*
2446 * Try to steal a single page from some fallback migratetype. Leave the rest of
2447 * the block as its current migratetype, potentially causing fragmentation.
2448 */
2449static __always_inline struct page *
2450__rmqueue_steal(struct zone *zone, int order, int start_migratetype)
2451{
2452 struct free_area *area;
2453 int current_order;
2454 struct page *page;
2455 int fallback_mt;
2456
2457 for (current_order = order; current_order < NR_PAGE_ORDERS; current_order++) {
2458 area = &(zone->free_area[current_order]);
2459 fallback_mt = find_suitable_fallback(area, current_order,
2460 start_migratetype, false);
2461 if (fallback_mt == -1)
2462 continue;
2463
2464 page = get_page_from_free_area(area, fallback_mt);
2465 page_del_and_expand(zone, page, order, current_order, fallback_mt);
2466 trace_mm_page_alloc_extfrag(page, order, current_order,
2467 start_migratetype, fallback_mt);
2468 return page;
2469 }
2470
2471 return NULL;
2472}
2473
2474enum rmqueue_mode {
2475 RMQUEUE_NORMAL,
2476 RMQUEUE_CMA,
2477 RMQUEUE_CLAIM,
2478 RMQUEUE_STEAL,
2479};
2480
2481/*
2482 * Do the hard work of removing an element from the buddy allocator.
2483 * Call me with the zone->lock already held.
2484 */
2485static __always_inline struct page *
2486__rmqueue(struct zone *zone, unsigned int order, int migratetype,
2487 unsigned int alloc_flags, enum rmqueue_mode *mode)
2488{
2489 struct page *page;
2490
2491 if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_CMA)) {
2492 /*
2493 * Balance movable allocations between regular and CMA areas by
2494 * allocating from CMA when over half of the zone's free memory
2495 * is in the CMA area.
2496 */
2497 if (alloc_flags & ALLOC_CMA &&
2498 zone_page_state(zone, NR_FREE_CMA_PAGES) >
2499 zone_page_state(zone, NR_FREE_PAGES) / 2) {
2500 page = __rmqueue_cma_fallback(zone, order);
2501 if (page)
2502 return page;
2503 }
2504 }
2505
2506 /*
2507 * First try the freelists of the requested migratetype, then try
2508 * fallbacks modes with increasing levels of fragmentation risk.
2509 *
2510 * The fallback logic is expensive and rmqueue_bulk() calls in
2511 * a loop with the zone->lock held, meaning the freelists are
2512 * not subject to any outside changes. Remember in *mode where
2513 * we found pay dirt, to save us the search on the next call.
2514 */
2515 switch (*mode) {
2516 case RMQUEUE_NORMAL:
2517 page = __rmqueue_smallest(zone, order, migratetype);
2518 if (page)
2519 return page;
2520 fallthrough;
2521 case RMQUEUE_CMA:
2522 if (alloc_flags & ALLOC_CMA) {
2523 page = __rmqueue_cma_fallback(zone, order);
2524 if (page) {
2525 *mode = RMQUEUE_CMA;
2526 return page;
2527 }
2528 }
2529 fallthrough;
2530 case RMQUEUE_CLAIM:
2531 page = __rmqueue_claim(zone, order, migratetype, alloc_flags);
2532 if (page) {
2533 /* Replenished preferred freelist, back to normal mode. */
2534 *mode = RMQUEUE_NORMAL;
2535 return page;
2536 }
2537 fallthrough;
2538 case RMQUEUE_STEAL:
2539 if (!(alloc_flags & ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT)) {
2540 page = __rmqueue_steal(zone, order, migratetype);
2541 if (page) {
2542 *mode = RMQUEUE_STEAL;
2543 return page;
2544 }
2545 }
2546 }
2547 return NULL;
2548}
2549
2550/*
2551 * Obtain a specified number of elements from the buddy allocator, all under
2552 * a single hold of the lock, for efficiency. Add them to the supplied list.
2553 * Returns the number of new pages which were placed at *list.
2554 */
2555static int rmqueue_bulk(struct zone *zone, unsigned int order,
2556 unsigned long count, struct list_head *list,
2557 int migratetype, unsigned int alloc_flags)
2558{
2559 enum rmqueue_mode rmqm = RMQUEUE_NORMAL;
2560 unsigned long flags;
2561 int i;
2562
2563 if (unlikely(alloc_flags & ALLOC_TRYLOCK)) {
2564 if (!spin_trylock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags))
2565 return 0;
2566 } else {
2567 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
2568 }
2569 for (i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
2570 struct page *page = __rmqueue(zone, order, migratetype,
2571 alloc_flags, &rmqm);
2572 if (unlikely(page == NULL))
2573 break;
2574
2575 /*
2576 * Split buddy pages returned by expand() are received here in
2577 * physical page order. The page is added to the tail of
2578 * caller's list. From the callers perspective, the linked list
2579 * is ordered by page number under some conditions. This is
2580 * useful for IO devices that can forward direction from the
2581 * head, thus also in the physical page order. This is useful
2582 * for IO devices that can merge IO requests if the physical
2583 * pages are ordered properly.
2584 */
2585 list_add_tail(&page->pcp_list, list);
2586 }
2587 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
2588
2589 return i;
2590}
2591
2592/*
2593 * Called from the vmstat counter updater to decay the PCP high.
2594 * Return whether there are addition works to do.
2595 */
2596bool decay_pcp_high(struct zone *zone, struct per_cpu_pages *pcp)
2597{
2598 int high_min, to_drain, to_drain_batched, batch;
2599 unsigned long UP_flags;
2600 bool todo = false;
2601
2602 high_min = READ_ONCE(pcp->high_min);
2603 batch = READ_ONCE(pcp->batch);
2604 /*
2605 * Decrease pcp->high periodically to try to free possible
2606 * idle PCP pages. And, avoid to free too many pages to
2607 * control latency. This caps pcp->high decrement too.
2608 */
2609 if (pcp->high > high_min) {
2610 pcp->high = max3(pcp->count - (batch << CONFIG_PCP_BATCH_SCALE_MAX),
2611 pcp->high - (pcp->high >> 3), high_min);
2612 if (pcp->high > high_min)
2613 todo = true;
2614 }
2615
2616 to_drain = pcp->count - pcp->high;
2617 while (to_drain > 0) {
2618 to_drain_batched = min(to_drain, batch);
2619 pcp_spin_lock_maybe_irqsave(pcp, UP_flags);
2620 free_pcppages_bulk(zone, to_drain_batched, pcp, 0);
2621 pcp_spin_unlock_maybe_irqrestore(pcp, UP_flags);
2622 todo = true;
2623
2624 to_drain -= to_drain_batched;
2625 }
2626
2627 return todo;
2628}
2629
2630#ifdef CONFIG_NUMA
2631/*
2632 * Called from the vmstat counter updater to drain pagesets of this
2633 * currently executing processor on remote nodes after they have
2634 * expired.
2635 */
2636void drain_zone_pages(struct zone *zone, struct per_cpu_pages *pcp)
2637{
2638 unsigned long UP_flags;
2639 int to_drain, batch;
2640
2641 batch = READ_ONCE(pcp->batch);
2642 to_drain = min(pcp->count, batch);
2643 if (to_drain > 0) {
2644 pcp_spin_lock_maybe_irqsave(pcp, UP_flags);
2645 free_pcppages_bulk(zone, to_drain, pcp, 0);
2646 pcp_spin_unlock_maybe_irqrestore(pcp, UP_flags);
2647 }
2648}
2649#endif
2650
2651/*
2652 * Drain pcplists of the indicated processor and zone.
2653 */
2654static void drain_pages_zone(unsigned int cpu, struct zone *zone)
2655{
2656 struct per_cpu_pages *pcp = per_cpu_ptr(zone->per_cpu_pageset, cpu);
2657 unsigned long UP_flags;
2658 int count;
2659
2660 do {
2661 pcp_spin_lock_maybe_irqsave(pcp, UP_flags);
2662 count = pcp->count;
2663 if (count) {
2664 int to_drain = min(count,
2665 pcp->batch << CONFIG_PCP_BATCH_SCALE_MAX);
2666
2667 free_pcppages_bulk(zone, to_drain, pcp, 0);
2668 count -= to_drain;
2669 }
2670 pcp_spin_unlock_maybe_irqrestore(pcp, UP_flags);
2671 } while (count);
2672}
2673
2674/*
2675 * Drain pcplists of all zones on the indicated processor.
2676 */
2677static void drain_pages(unsigned int cpu)
2678{
2679 struct zone *zone;
2680
2681 for_each_populated_zone(zone) {
2682 drain_pages_zone(cpu, zone);
2683 }
2684}
2685
2686/*
2687 * Spill all of this CPU's per-cpu pages back into the buddy allocator.
2688 */
2689void drain_local_pages(struct zone *zone)
2690{
2691 int cpu = smp_processor_id();
2692
2693 if (zone)
2694 drain_pages_zone(cpu, zone);
2695 else
2696 drain_pages(cpu);
2697}
2698
2699/*
2700 * The implementation of drain_all_pages(), exposing an extra parameter to
2701 * drain on all cpus.
2702 *
2703 * drain_all_pages() is optimized to only execute on cpus where pcplists are
2704 * not empty. The check for non-emptiness can however race with a free to
2705 * pcplist that has not yet increased the pcp->count from 0 to 1. Callers
2706 * that need the guarantee that every CPU has drained can disable the
2707 * optimizing racy check.
2708 */
2709static void __drain_all_pages(struct zone *zone, bool force_all_cpus)
2710{
2711 int cpu;
2712
2713 /*
2714 * Allocate in the BSS so we won't require allocation in
2715 * direct reclaim path for CONFIG_CPUMASK_OFFSTACK=y
2716 */
2717 static cpumask_t cpus_with_pcps;
2718
2719 /*
2720 * Do not drain if one is already in progress unless it's specific to
2721 * a zone. Such callers are primarily CMA and memory hotplug and need
2722 * the drain to be complete when the call returns.
2723 */
2724 if (unlikely(!mutex_trylock(&pcpu_drain_mutex))) {
2725 if (!zone)
2726 return;
2727 mutex_lock(&pcpu_drain_mutex);
2728 }
2729
2730 /*
2731 * We don't care about racing with CPU hotplug event
2732 * as offline notification will cause the notified
2733 * cpu to drain that CPU pcps and on_each_cpu_mask
2734 * disables preemption as part of its processing
2735 */
2736 for_each_online_cpu(cpu) {
2737 struct per_cpu_pages *pcp;
2738 struct zone *z;
2739 bool has_pcps = false;
2740
2741 if (force_all_cpus) {
2742 /*
2743 * The pcp.count check is racy, some callers need a
2744 * guarantee that no cpu is missed.
2745 */
2746 has_pcps = true;
2747 } else if (zone) {
2748 pcp = per_cpu_ptr(zone->per_cpu_pageset, cpu);
2749 if (pcp->count)
2750 has_pcps = true;
2751 } else {
2752 for_each_populated_zone(z) {
2753 pcp = per_cpu_ptr(z->per_cpu_pageset, cpu);
2754 if (pcp->count) {
2755 has_pcps = true;
2756 break;
2757 }
2758 }
2759 }
2760
2761 if (has_pcps)
2762 cpumask_set_cpu(cpu, &cpus_with_pcps);
2763 else
2764 cpumask_clear_cpu(cpu, &cpus_with_pcps);
2765 }
2766
2767 for_each_cpu(cpu, &cpus_with_pcps) {
2768 if (zone)
2769 drain_pages_zone(cpu, zone);
2770 else
2771 drain_pages(cpu);
2772 }
2773
2774 mutex_unlock(&pcpu_drain_mutex);
2775}
2776
2777/*
2778 * Spill all the per-cpu pages from all CPUs back into the buddy allocator.
2779 *
2780 * When zone parameter is non-NULL, spill just the single zone's pages.
2781 */
2782void drain_all_pages(struct zone *zone)
2783{
2784 __drain_all_pages(zone, false);
2785}
2786
2787static int nr_pcp_free(struct per_cpu_pages *pcp, int batch, int high, bool free_high)
2788{
2789 int min_nr_free, max_nr_free;
2790
2791 /* Free as much as possible if batch freeing high-order pages. */
2792 if (unlikely(free_high))
2793 return min(pcp->count, batch << CONFIG_PCP_BATCH_SCALE_MAX);
2794
2795 /* Check for PCP disabled or boot pageset */
2796 if (unlikely(high < batch))
2797 return 1;
2798
2799 /* Leave at least pcp->batch pages on the list */
2800 min_nr_free = batch;
2801 max_nr_free = high - batch;
2802
2803 /*
2804 * Increase the batch number to the number of the consecutive
2805 * freed pages to reduce zone lock contention.
2806 */
2807 batch = clamp_t(int, pcp->free_count, min_nr_free, max_nr_free);
2808
2809 return batch;
2810}
2811
2812static int nr_pcp_high(struct per_cpu_pages *pcp, struct zone *zone,
2813 int batch, bool free_high)
2814{
2815 int high, high_min, high_max;
2816
2817 high_min = READ_ONCE(pcp->high_min);
2818 high_max = READ_ONCE(pcp->high_max);
2819 high = pcp->high = clamp(pcp->high, high_min, high_max);
2820
2821 if (unlikely(!high))
2822 return 0;
2823
2824 if (unlikely(free_high)) {
2825 pcp->high = max(high - (batch << CONFIG_PCP_BATCH_SCALE_MAX),
2826 high_min);
2827 return 0;
2828 }
2829
2830 /*
2831 * If reclaim is active, limit the number of pages that can be
2832 * stored on pcp lists
2833 */
2834 if (test_bit(ZONE_RECLAIM_ACTIVE, &zone->flags)) {
2835 int free_count = max_t(int, pcp->free_count, batch);
2836
2837 pcp->high = max(high - free_count, high_min);
2838 return min(batch << 2, pcp->high);
2839 }
2840
2841 if (high_min == high_max)
2842 return high;
2843
2844 if (test_bit(ZONE_BELOW_HIGH, &zone->flags)) {
2845 int free_count = max_t(int, pcp->free_count, batch);
2846
2847 pcp->high = max(high - free_count, high_min);
2848 high = max(pcp->count, high_min);
2849 } else if (pcp->count >= high) {
2850 int need_high = pcp->free_count + batch;
2851
2852 /* pcp->high should be large enough to hold batch freed pages */
2853 if (pcp->high < need_high)
2854 pcp->high = clamp(need_high, high_min, high_max);
2855 }
2856
2857 return high;
2858}
2859
2860/*
2861 * Tune pcp alloc factor and adjust count & free_count. Free pages to bring the
2862 * pcp's watermarks below high.
2863 *
2864 * May return a freed pcp, if during page freeing the pcp spinlock cannot be
2865 * reacquired. Return true if pcp is locked, false otherwise.
2866 */
2867static bool free_frozen_page_commit(struct zone *zone,
2868 struct per_cpu_pages *pcp, struct page *page, int migratetype,
2869 unsigned int order, fpi_t fpi_flags, unsigned long *UP_flags)
2870{
2871 int high, batch;
2872 int to_free, to_free_batched;
2873 int pindex;
2874 int cpu = smp_processor_id();
2875 int ret = true;
2876 bool free_high = false;
2877
2878 /*
2879 * On freeing, reduce the number of pages that are batch allocated.
2880 * See nr_pcp_alloc() where alloc_factor is increased for subsequent
2881 * allocations.
2882 */
2883 pcp->alloc_factor >>= 1;
2884 __count_vm_events(PGFREE, 1 << order);
2885 pindex = order_to_pindex(migratetype, order);
2886 list_add(&page->pcp_list, &pcp->lists[pindex]);
2887 pcp->count += 1 << order;
2888
2889 batch = READ_ONCE(pcp->batch);
2890 /*
2891 * As high-order pages other than THP's stored on PCP can contribute
2892 * to fragmentation, limit the number stored when PCP is heavily
2893 * freeing without allocation. The remainder after bulk freeing
2894 * stops will be drained from vmstat refresh context.
2895 */
2896 if (order && order <= PAGE_ALLOC_COSTLY_ORDER) {
2897 free_high = (pcp->free_count >= (batch + pcp->high_min / 2) &&
2898 (pcp->flags & PCPF_PREV_FREE_HIGH_ORDER) &&
2899 (!(pcp->flags & PCPF_FREE_HIGH_BATCH) ||
2900 pcp->count >= batch));
2901 pcp->flags |= PCPF_PREV_FREE_HIGH_ORDER;
2902 } else if (pcp->flags & PCPF_PREV_FREE_HIGH_ORDER) {
2903 pcp->flags &= ~PCPF_PREV_FREE_HIGH_ORDER;
2904 }
2905 if (pcp->free_count < (batch << CONFIG_PCP_BATCH_SCALE_MAX))
2906 pcp->free_count += (1 << order);
2907
2908 if (unlikely(fpi_flags & FPI_TRYLOCK)) {
2909 /*
2910 * Do not attempt to take a zone lock. Let pcp->count get
2911 * over high mark temporarily.
2912 */
2913 return true;
2914 }
2915
2916 high = nr_pcp_high(pcp, zone, batch, free_high);
2917 if (pcp->count < high)
2918 return true;
2919
2920 to_free = nr_pcp_free(pcp, batch, high, free_high);
2921 while (to_free > 0 && pcp->count > 0) {
2922 to_free_batched = min(to_free, batch);
2923 free_pcppages_bulk(zone, to_free_batched, pcp, pindex);
2924 to_free -= to_free_batched;
2925
2926 if (to_free == 0 || pcp->count == 0)
2927 break;
2928
2929 pcp_spin_unlock(pcp, *UP_flags);
2930
2931 pcp = pcp_spin_trylock(zone->per_cpu_pageset, *UP_flags);
2932 if (!pcp) {
2933 ret = false;
2934 break;
2935 }
2936
2937 /*
2938 * Check if this thread has been migrated to a different CPU.
2939 * If that is the case, give up and indicate that the pcp is
2940 * returned in an unlocked state.
2941 */
2942 if (smp_processor_id() != cpu) {
2943 pcp_spin_unlock(pcp, *UP_flags);
2944 ret = false;
2945 break;
2946 }
2947 }
2948
2949 if (test_bit(ZONE_BELOW_HIGH, &zone->flags) &&
2950 zone_watermark_ok(zone, 0, high_wmark_pages(zone),
2951 ZONE_MOVABLE, 0)) {
2952 struct pglist_data *pgdat = zone->zone_pgdat;
2953 clear_bit(ZONE_BELOW_HIGH, &zone->flags);
2954
2955 /*
2956 * Assume that memory pressure on this node is gone and may be
2957 * in a reclaimable state. If a memory fallback node exists,
2958 * direct reclaim may not have been triggered, causing a
2959 * 'hopeless node' to stay in that state for a while. Let
2960 * kswapd work again by resetting kswapd_failures.
2961 */
2962 if (kswapd_test_hopeless(pgdat) &&
2963 next_memory_node(pgdat->node_id) < MAX_NUMNODES)
2964 kswapd_clear_hopeless(pgdat, KSWAPD_CLEAR_HOPELESS_PCP);
2965 }
2966 return ret;
2967}
2968
2969/*
2970 * Free a pcp page
2971 */
2972static void __free_frozen_pages(struct page *page, unsigned int order,
2973 fpi_t fpi_flags)
2974{
2975 unsigned long UP_flags;
2976 struct per_cpu_pages *pcp;
2977 struct zone *zone;
2978 unsigned long pfn = page_to_pfn(page);
2979 int migratetype;
2980
2981 if (!pcp_allowed_order(order)) {
2982 __free_pages_ok(page, order, fpi_flags);
2983 return;
2984 }
2985
2986 if (!__free_pages_prepare(page, order, fpi_flags))
2987 return;
2988
2989 /*
2990 * We only track unmovable, reclaimable and movable on pcp lists.
2991 * Place ISOLATE pages on the isolated list because they are being
2992 * offlined but treat HIGHATOMIC and CMA as movable pages so we can
2993 * get those areas back if necessary. Otherwise, we may have to free
2994 * excessively into the page allocator
2995 */
2996 zone = page_zone(page);
2997 migratetype = get_pfnblock_migratetype(page, pfn);
2998 if (unlikely(migratetype >= MIGRATE_PCPTYPES)) {
2999 if (unlikely(is_migrate_isolate(migratetype))) {
3000 free_one_page(zone, page, pfn, order, fpi_flags);
3001 return;
3002 }
3003 migratetype = MIGRATE_MOVABLE;
3004 }
3005
3006 if (unlikely((fpi_flags & FPI_TRYLOCK) && IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_PREEMPT_RT)
3007 && (in_nmi() || in_hardirq()))) {
3008 add_page_to_zone_llist(zone, page, order);
3009 return;
3010 }
3011 pcp = pcp_spin_trylock(zone->per_cpu_pageset, UP_flags);
3012 if (pcp) {
3013 if (!free_frozen_page_commit(zone, pcp, page, migratetype,
3014 order, fpi_flags, &UP_flags))
3015 return;
3016 pcp_spin_unlock(pcp, UP_flags);
3017 } else {
3018 free_one_page(zone, page, pfn, order, fpi_flags);
3019 }
3020}
3021
3022void free_frozen_pages(struct page *page, unsigned int order)
3023{
3024 __free_frozen_pages(page, order, FPI_NONE);
3025}
3026
3027void free_frozen_pages_nolock(struct page *page, unsigned int order)
3028{
3029 __free_frozen_pages(page, order, FPI_TRYLOCK);
3030}
3031
3032/*
3033 * Free a batch of folios
3034 */
3035void free_unref_folios(struct folio_batch *folios)
3036{
3037 unsigned long UP_flags;
3038 struct per_cpu_pages *pcp = NULL;
3039 struct zone *locked_zone = NULL;
3040 int i, j;
3041
3042 /* Prepare folios for freeing */
3043 for (i = 0, j = 0; i < folios->nr; i++) {
3044 struct folio *folio = folios->folios[i];
3045 unsigned long pfn = folio_pfn(folio);
3046 unsigned int order = folio_order(folio);
3047
3048 if (!__free_pages_prepare(&folio->page, order, FPI_NONE))
3049 continue;
3050 /*
3051 * Free orders not handled on the PCP directly to the
3052 * allocator.
3053 */
3054 if (!pcp_allowed_order(order)) {
3055 free_one_page(folio_zone(folio), &folio->page,
3056 pfn, order, FPI_NONE);
3057 continue;
3058 }
3059 folio->private = (void *)(unsigned long)order;
3060 if (j != i)
3061 folios->folios[j] = folio;
3062 j++;
3063 }
3064 folios->nr = j;
3065
3066 for (i = 0; i < folios->nr; i++) {
3067 struct folio *folio = folios->folios[i];
3068 struct zone *zone = folio_zone(folio);
3069 unsigned long pfn = folio_pfn(folio);
3070 unsigned int order = (unsigned long)folio->private;
3071 int migratetype;
3072
3073 folio->private = NULL;
3074 migratetype = get_pfnblock_migratetype(&folio->page, pfn);
3075
3076 /* Different zone requires a different pcp lock */
3077 if (zone != locked_zone ||
3078 is_migrate_isolate(migratetype)) {
3079 if (pcp) {
3080 pcp_spin_unlock(pcp, UP_flags);
3081 locked_zone = NULL;
3082 pcp = NULL;
3083 }
3084
3085 /*
3086 * Free isolated pages directly to the
3087 * allocator, see comment in free_frozen_pages.
3088 */
3089 if (is_migrate_isolate(migratetype)) {
3090 free_one_page(zone, &folio->page, pfn,
3091 order, FPI_NONE);
3092 continue;
3093 }
3094
3095 /*
3096 * trylock is necessary as folios may be getting freed
3097 * from IRQ or SoftIRQ context after an IO completion.
3098 */
3099 pcp = pcp_spin_trylock(zone->per_cpu_pageset, UP_flags);
3100 if (unlikely(!pcp)) {
3101 free_one_page(zone, &folio->page, pfn,
3102 order, FPI_NONE);
3103 continue;
3104 }
3105 locked_zone = zone;
3106 }
3107
3108 /*
3109 * Non-isolated types over MIGRATE_PCPTYPES get added
3110 * to the MIGRATE_MOVABLE pcp list.
3111 */
3112 if (unlikely(migratetype >= MIGRATE_PCPTYPES))
3113 migratetype = MIGRATE_MOVABLE;
3114
3115 trace_mm_page_free_batched(&folio->page);
3116 if (!free_frozen_page_commit(zone, pcp, &folio->page,
3117 migratetype, order, FPI_NONE, &UP_flags)) {
3118 pcp = NULL;
3119 locked_zone = NULL;
3120 }
3121 }
3122
3123 if (pcp)
3124 pcp_spin_unlock(pcp, UP_flags);
3125 folio_batch_reinit(folios);
3126}
3127
3128static void __split_page(struct page *page, unsigned int order)
3129{
3130 VM_WARN_ON_PAGE(PageCompound(page), page);
3131
3132 split_page_owner(page, order, 0);
3133 pgalloc_tag_split(page_folio(page), order, 0);
3134 split_page_memcg(page, order);
3135}
3136
3137/*
3138 * split_page takes a non-compound higher-order page, and splits it into
3139 * n (1<<order) sub-pages: page[0..n]
3140 * Each sub-page must be freed individually.
3141 *
3142 * Note: this is probably too low level an operation for use in drivers.
3143 * Please consult with lkml before using this in your driver.
3144 */
3145void split_page(struct page *page, unsigned int order)
3146{
3147 int i;
3148
3149 VM_WARN_ON_PAGE(!page_count(page), page);
3150
3151 for (i = 1; i < (1 << order); i++)
3152 set_page_refcounted(page + i);
3153
3154 __split_page(page, order);
3155}
3156EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(split_page);
3157
3158int __isolate_free_page(struct page *page, unsigned int order)
3159{
3160 struct zone *zone = page_zone(page);
3161 int mt = get_pageblock_migratetype(page);
3162
3163 if (!is_migrate_isolate(mt)) {
3164 unsigned long watermark;
3165 /*
3166 * Obey watermarks as if the page was being allocated. We can
3167 * emulate a high-order watermark check with a raised order-0
3168 * watermark, because we already know our high-order page
3169 * exists.
3170 */
3171 watermark = zone->_watermark[WMARK_MIN] + (1UL << order);
3172 if (!zone_watermark_ok(zone, 0, watermark, 0, ALLOC_CMA))
3173 return 0;
3174 }
3175
3176 del_page_from_free_list(page, zone, order, mt);
3177
3178 /*
3179 * Set the pageblock if the isolated page is at least half of a
3180 * pageblock
3181 */
3182 if (order >= pageblock_order - 1) {
3183 struct page *endpage = page + (1 << order) - 1;
3184 for (; page < endpage; page += pageblock_nr_pages) {
3185 int mt = get_pageblock_migratetype(page);
3186 /*
3187 * Only change normal pageblocks (i.e., they can merge
3188 * with others)
3189 */
3190 if (migratetype_is_mergeable(mt))
3191 move_freepages_block(zone, page, mt,
3192 MIGRATE_MOVABLE);
3193 }
3194 }
3195
3196 return 1UL << order;
3197}
3198
3208void __putback_isolated_page(struct page *page, unsigned int order, int mt)
3209{
3210 struct zone *zone = page_zone(page);
3211
3212 /* zone lock should be held when this function is called */
3213 lockdep_assert_held(&zone->lock);
3214
3215 /* Return isolated page to tail of freelist. */
3216 __free_one_page(page, page_to_pfn(page), zone, order, mt,
3217 FPI_SKIP_REPORT_NOTIFY | FPI_TO_TAIL);
3218}

3220/*
3221 * Update NUMA hit/miss statistics
3222 */
3223static inline void zone_statistics(struct zone *preferred_zone, struct zone *z,
3224 long nr_account)
3225{
3226#ifdef CONFIG_NUMA
3227 enum numa_stat_item local_stat = NUMA_LOCAL;
3228
3229 /* skip numa counters update if numa stats is disabled */
3230 if (!static_branch_likely(&vm_numa_stat_key))
3231 return;
3232
3233 if (zone_to_nid(z) != numa_node_id())
3234 local_stat = NUMA_OTHER;
3235
3236 if (zone_to_nid(z) == zone_to_nid(preferred_zone))
3237 __count_numa_events(z, NUMA_HIT, nr_account);
3238 else {
3239 __count_numa_events(z, NUMA_MISS, nr_account);
3240 __count_numa_events(preferred_zone, NUMA_FOREIGN, nr_account);
3241 }
3242 __count_numa_events(z, local_stat, nr_account);
3243#endif
3244}
3245
3246static __always_inline
3247struct page *rmqueue_buddy(struct zone *preferred_zone, struct zone *zone,
3248 unsigned int order, unsigned int alloc_flags,
3249 int migratetype)
3250{
3251 struct page *page;
3252 unsigned long flags;
3253
3254 do {
3255 page = NULL;
3256 if (unlikely(alloc_flags & ALLOC_TRYLOCK)) {
3257 if (!spin_trylock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags))
3258 return NULL;
3259 } else {
3260 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
3261 }
3262 if (alloc_flags & ALLOC_HIGHATOMIC)
3263 page = __rmqueue_smallest(zone, order, MIGRATE_HIGHATOMIC);
3264 if (!page) {
3265 enum rmqueue_mode rmqm = RMQUEUE_NORMAL;
3266
3267 page = __rmqueue(zone, order, migratetype, alloc_flags, &rmqm);
3268
3269 /*
3270 * If the allocation fails, allow OOM handling and
3271 * order-0 (atomic) allocs access to HIGHATOMIC
3272 * reserves as failing now is worse than failing a
3273 * high-order atomic allocation in the future.
3274 */
3275 if (!page && (alloc_flags & (ALLOC_OOM|ALLOC_NON_BLOCK)))
3276 page = __rmqueue_smallest(zone, order, MIGRATE_HIGHATOMIC);
3277
3278 if (!page) {
3279 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
3280 return NULL;
3281 }
3282 }
3283 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
3284 } while (check_new_pages(page, order));
3285
3286 __count_zid_vm_events(PGALLOC, page_zonenum(page), 1 << order);
3287 zone_statistics(preferred_zone, zone, 1);
3288
3289 return page;
3290}
3291
3292static int nr_pcp_alloc(struct per_cpu_pages *pcp, struct zone *zone, int order)
3293{
3294 int high, base_batch, batch, max_nr_alloc;
3295 int high_max, high_min;
3296
3297 base_batch = READ_ONCE(pcp->batch);
3298 high_min = READ_ONCE(pcp->high_min);
3299 high_max = READ_ONCE(pcp->high_max);
3300 high = pcp->high = clamp(pcp->high, high_min, high_max);
3301
3302 /* Check for PCP disabled or boot pageset */
3303 if (unlikely(high < base_batch))
3304 return 1;
3305
3306 if (order)
3307 batch = base_batch;
3308 else
3309 batch = (base_batch << pcp->alloc_factor);
3310
3311 /*
3312 * If we had larger pcp->high, we could avoid to allocate from
3313 * zone.
3314 */
3315 if (high_min != high_max && !test_bit(ZONE_BELOW_HIGH, &zone->flags))
3316 high = pcp->high = min(high + batch, high_max);
3317
3318 if (!order) {
3319 max_nr_alloc = max(high - pcp->count - base_batch, base_batch);
3320 /*
3321 * Double the number of pages allocated each time there is
3322 * subsequent allocation of order-0 pages without any freeing.
3323 */
3324 if (batch <= max_nr_alloc &&
3325 pcp->alloc_factor < CONFIG_PCP_BATCH_SCALE_MAX)
3326 pcp->alloc_factor++;
3327 batch = min(batch, max_nr_alloc);
3328 }
3329
3330 /*
3331 * Scale batch relative to order if batch implies free pages
3332 * can be stored on the PCP. Batch can be 1 for small zones or
3333 * for boot pagesets which should never store free pages as
3334 * the pages may belong to arbitrary zones.
3335 */
3336 if (batch > 1)
3337 batch = max(batch >> order, 2);
3338
3339 return batch;
3340}
3341
3342/* Remove page from the per-cpu list, caller must protect the list */
3343static inline
3344struct page *__rmqueue_pcplist(struct zone *zone, unsigned int order,
3345 int migratetype,
3346 unsigned int alloc_flags,
3347 struct per_cpu_pages *pcp,
3348 struct list_head *list)
3349{
3350 struct page *page;
3351
3352 do {
3353 if (list_empty(list)) {
3354 int batch = nr_pcp_alloc(pcp, zone, order);
3355 int alloced;
3356
3357 alloced = rmqueue_bulk(zone, order,
3358 batch, list,
3359 migratetype, alloc_flags);
3360
3361 pcp->count += alloced << order;
3362 if (unlikely(list_empty(list)))
3363 return NULL;
3364 }
3365
3366 page = list_first_entry(list, struct page, pcp_list);
3367 list_del(&page->pcp_list);
3368 pcp->count -= 1 << order;
3369 } while (check_new_pages(page, order));
3370
3371 return page;
3372}
3373
3374/* Lock and remove page from the per-cpu list */
3375static struct page *rmqueue_pcplist(struct zone *preferred_zone,
3376 struct zone *zone, unsigned int order,
3377 int migratetype, unsigned int alloc_flags)
3378{
3379 struct per_cpu_pages *pcp;
3380 struct list_head *list;
3381 struct page *page;
3382 unsigned long UP_flags;
3383
3384 /* spin_trylock may fail due to a parallel drain or IRQ reentrancy. */
3385 pcp = pcp_spin_trylock(zone->per_cpu_pageset, UP_flags);
3386 if (!pcp)
3387 return NULL;
3388
3389 /*
3390 * On allocation, reduce the number of pages that are batch freed.
3391 * See nr_pcp_free() where free_factor is increased for subsequent
3392 * frees.
3393 */
3394 pcp->free_count >>= 1;
3395 list = &pcp->lists[order_to_pindex(migratetype, order)];
3396 page = __rmqueue_pcplist(zone, order, migratetype, alloc_flags, pcp, list);
3397 pcp_spin_unlock(pcp, UP_flags);
3398 if (page) {
3399 __count_zid_vm_events(PGALLOC, page_zonenum(page), 1 << order);
3400 zone_statistics(preferred_zone, zone, 1);
3401 }
3402 return page;
3403}
3404
3405/*
3406 * Allocate a page from the given zone.
3407 * Use pcplists for THP or "cheap" high-order allocations.
3408 */
3409
3410/*
3411 * Do not instrument rmqueue() with KMSAN. This function may call
3412 * __msan_poison_alloca() through a call to set_pfnblock_migratetype().
3413 * If __msan_poison_alloca() attempts to allocate pages for the stack depot, it
3414 * may call rmqueue() again, which will result in a deadlock.
3415 */
3416__no_sanitize_memory
3417static inline
3418struct page *rmqueue(struct zone *preferred_zone,
3419 struct zone *zone, unsigned int order,
3420 gfp_t gfp_flags, unsigned int alloc_flags,
3421 int migratetype)
3422{
3423 struct page *page;
3424
3425 if (likely(pcp_allowed_order(order))) {
3426 page = rmqueue_pcplist(preferred_zone, zone, order,
3427 migratetype, alloc_flags);
3428 if (likely(page))
3429 goto out;
3430 }
3431
3432 page = rmqueue_buddy(preferred_zone, zone, order, alloc_flags,
3433 migratetype);
3434
3435out:
3436 /* Separate test+clear to avoid unnecessary atomics */
3437 if ((alloc_flags & ALLOC_KSWAPD) &&
3438 unlikely(test_bit(ZONE_BOOSTED_WATERMARK, &zone->flags))) {
3439 clear_bit(ZONE_BOOSTED_WATERMARK, &zone->flags);
3440 wakeup_kswapd(zone, 0, 0, zone_idx(zone));
3441 }
3442
3443 VM_BUG_ON_PAGE(page && bad_range(zone, page), page);
3444 return page;
3445}
3446
3447/*
3448 * Reserve the pageblock(s) surrounding an allocation request for
3449 * exclusive use of high-order atomic allocations if there are no
3450 * empty page blocks that contain a page with a suitable order
3451 */
3452static void reserve_highatomic_pageblock(struct page *page, int order,
3453 struct zone *zone)
3454{
3455 int mt;
3456 unsigned long max_managed, flags;
3457
3458 /*
3459 * The number reserved as: minimum is 1 pageblock, maximum is
3460 * roughly 1% of a zone. But if 1% of a zone falls below a
3461 * pageblock size, then don't reserve any pageblocks.
3462 * Check is race-prone but harmless.
3463 */
3464 if ((zone_managed_pages(zone) / 100) < pageblock_nr_pages)
3465 return;
3466 max_managed = ALIGN((zone_managed_pages(zone) / 100), pageblock_nr_pages);
3467 if (zone->nr_reserved_highatomic >= max_managed)
3468 return;
3469
3470 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
3471
3472 /* Recheck the nr_reserved_highatomic limit under the lock */
3473 if (zone->nr_reserved_highatomic >= max_managed)
3474 goto out_unlock;
3475
3476 /* Yoink! */
3477 mt = get_pageblock_migratetype(page);
3478 /* Only reserve normal pageblocks (i.e., they can merge with others) */
3479 if (!migratetype_is_mergeable(mt))
3480 goto out_unlock;
3481
3482 if (order < pageblock_order) {
3483 if (move_freepages_block(zone, page, mt, MIGRATE_HIGHATOMIC) == -1)
3484 goto out_unlock;
3485 zone->nr_reserved_highatomic += pageblock_nr_pages;
3486 } else {
3487 change_pageblock_range(page, order, MIGRATE_HIGHATOMIC);
3488 zone->nr_reserved_highatomic += 1 << order;
3489 }
3490
3491out_unlock:
3492 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
3493}
3494
3495/*
3496 * Used when an allocation is about to fail under memory pressure. This
3497 * potentially hurts the reliability of high-order allocations when under
3498 * intense memory pressure but failed atomic allocations should be easier
3499 * to recover from than an OOM.
3500 *
3501 * If @force is true, try to unreserve pageblocks even though highatomic
3502 * pageblock is exhausted.
3503 */
3504static bool unreserve_highatomic_pageblock(const struct alloc_context *ac,
3505 bool force)
3506{
3507 struct zonelist *zonelist = ac->zonelist;
3508 unsigned long flags;
3509 struct zoneref *z;
3510 struct zone *zone;
3511 struct page *page;
3512 int order;
3513 int ret;
3514
3515 for_each_zone_zonelist_nodemask(zone, z, zonelist, ac->highest_zoneidx,
3516 ac->nodemask) {
3517 /*
3518 * Preserve at least one pageblock unless memory pressure
3519 * is really high.
3520 */
3521 if (!force && zone->nr_reserved_highatomic <=
3522 pageblock_nr_pages)
3523 continue;
3524
3525 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
3526 for (order = 0; order < NR_PAGE_ORDERS; order++) {
3527 struct free_area *area = &(zone->free_area[order]);
3528 unsigned long size;
3529
3530 page = get_page_from_free_area(area, MIGRATE_HIGHATOMIC);
3531 if (!page)
3532 continue;
3533
3534 size = max(pageblock_nr_pages, 1UL << order);
3535 /*
3536 * It should never happen but changes to
3537 * locking could inadvertently allow a per-cpu
3538 * drain to add pages to MIGRATE_HIGHATOMIC
3539 * while unreserving so be safe and watch for
3540 * underflows.
3541 */
3542 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(size > zone->nr_reserved_highatomic))
3543 size = zone->nr_reserved_highatomic;
3544 zone->nr_reserved_highatomic -= size;
3545
3546 /*
3547 * Convert to ac->migratetype and avoid the normal
3548 * pageblock stealing heuristics. Minimally, the caller
3549 * is doing the work and needs the pages. More
3550 * importantly, if the block was always converted to
3551 * MIGRATE_UNMOVABLE or another type then the number
3552 * of pageblocks that cannot be completely freed
3553 * may increase.
3554 */
3555 if (order < pageblock_order)
3556 ret = move_freepages_block(zone, page,
3557 MIGRATE_HIGHATOMIC,
3558 ac->migratetype);
3559 else {
3560 move_to_free_list(page, zone, order,
3561 MIGRATE_HIGHATOMIC,
3562 ac->migratetype);
3563 change_pageblock_range(page, order,
3564 ac->migratetype);
3565 ret = 1;
3566 }
3567 /*
3568 * Reserving the block(s) already succeeded,
3569 * so this should not fail on zone boundaries.
3570 */
3571 WARN_ON_ONCE(ret == -1);
3572 if (ret > 0) {
3573 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
3574 return ret;
3575 }
3576 }
3577 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
3578 }
3579
3580 return false;
3581}
3582
3583static inline long __zone_watermark_unusable_free(struct zone *z,
3584 unsigned int order, unsigned int alloc_flags)
3585{
3586 long unusable_free = (1 << order) - 1;
3587
3588 /*
3589 * If the caller does not have rights to reserves below the min
3590 * watermark then subtract the free pages reserved for highatomic.
3591 */
3592 if (likely(!(alloc_flags & ALLOC_RESERVES)))
3593 unusable_free += READ_ONCE(z->nr_free_highatomic);
3594
3595#ifdef CONFIG_CMA
3596 /* If allocation can't use CMA areas don't use free CMA pages */
3597 if (!(alloc_flags & ALLOC_CMA))
3598 unusable_free += zone_page_state(z, NR_FREE_CMA_PAGES);
3599#endif
3600
3601 return unusable_free;
3602}
3603
3604/*
3605 * Return true if free base pages are above 'mark'. For high-order checks it
3606 * will return true of the order-0 watermark is reached and there is at least
3607 * one free page of a suitable size. Checking now avoids taking the zone lock
3608 * to check in the allocation paths if no pages are free.
3609 */
3610bool __zone_watermark_ok(struct zone *z, unsigned int order, unsigned long mark,
3611 int highest_zoneidx, unsigned int alloc_flags,
3612 long free_pages)
3613{
3614 long min = mark;
3615 int o;
3616
3617 /* free_pages may go negative - that's OK */
3618 free_pages -= __zone_watermark_unusable_free(z, order, alloc_flags);
3619
3620 if (unlikely(alloc_flags & ALLOC_RESERVES)) {
3621 /*
3622 * __GFP_HIGH allows access to 50% of the min reserve as well
3623 * as OOM.
3624 */
3625 if (alloc_flags & ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE) {
3626 min -= min / 2;
3627
3628 /*
3629 * Non-blocking allocations (e.g. GFP_ATOMIC) can
3630 * access more reserves than just __GFP_HIGH. Other
3631 * non-blocking allocations requests such as GFP_NOWAIT
3632 * or (GFP_KERNEL & ~__GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM) do not get
3633 * access to the min reserve.
3634 */
3635 if (alloc_flags & ALLOC_NON_BLOCK)
3636 min -= min / 4;
3637 }
3638
3639 /*
3640 * OOM victims can try even harder than the normal reserve
3641 * users on the grounds that it's definitely going to be in
3642 * the exit path shortly and free memory. Any allocation it
3643 * makes during the free path will be small and short-lived.
3644 */
3645 if (alloc_flags & ALLOC_OOM)
3646 min -= min / 2;
3647 }
3648
3649 /*
3650 * Check watermarks for an order-0 allocation request. If these
3651 * are not met, then a high-order request also cannot go ahead
3652 * even if a suitable page happened to be free.
3653 */
3654 if (free_pages <= min + z->lowmem_reserve[highest_zoneidx])
3655 return false;
3656
3657 /* If this is an order-0 request then the watermark is fine */
3658 if (!order)
3659 return true;
3660
3661 /* For a high-order request, check at least one suitable page is free */
3662 for (o = order; o < NR_PAGE_ORDERS; o++) {
3663 struct free_area *area = &z->free_area[o];
3664 int mt;
3665
3666 if (!area->nr_free)
3667 continue;
3668
3669 for (mt = 0; mt < MIGRATE_PCPTYPES; mt++) {
3670 if (!free_area_empty(area, mt))
3671 return true;
3672 }
3673
3674#ifdef CONFIG_CMA
3675 if ((alloc_flags & ALLOC_CMA) &&
3676 !free_area_empty(area, MIGRATE_CMA)) {
3677 return true;
3678 }
3679#endif
3680 if ((alloc_flags & (ALLOC_HIGHATOMIC|ALLOC_OOM)) &&
3681 !free_area_empty(area, MIGRATE_HIGHATOMIC)) {
3682 return true;
3683 }
3684 }
3685 return false;
3686}
3687
3688bool zone_watermark_ok(struct zone *z, unsigned int order, unsigned long mark,
3689 int highest_zoneidx, unsigned int alloc_flags)
3690{
3691 return __zone_watermark_ok(z, order, mark, highest_zoneidx, alloc_flags,
3692 zone_page_state(z, NR_FREE_PAGES));
3693}
3694
3695static inline bool zone_watermark_fast(struct zone *z, unsigned int order,
3696 unsigned long mark, int highest_zoneidx,
3697 unsigned int alloc_flags, gfp_t gfp_mask)
3698{
3699 long free_pages;
3700
3701 free_pages = zone_page_state(z, NR_FREE_PAGES);
3702
3703 /*
3704 * Fast check for order-0 only. If this fails then the reserves
3705 * need to be calculated.
3706 */
3707 if (!order) {
3708 long usable_free;
3709 long reserved;
3710
3711 usable_free = free_pages;
3712 reserved = __zone_watermark_unusable_free(z, 0, alloc_flags);
3713
3714 /* reserved may over estimate high-atomic reserves. */
3715 usable_free -= min(usable_free, reserved);
3716 if (usable_free > mark + z->lowmem_reserve[highest_zoneidx])
3717 return true;
3718 }
3719
3720 if (__zone_watermark_ok(z, order, mark, highest_zoneidx, alloc_flags,
3721 free_pages))
3722 return true;
3723
3724 /*
3725 * Ignore watermark boosting for __GFP_HIGH order-0 allocations
3726 * when checking the min watermark. The min watermark is the
3727 * point where boosting is ignored so that kswapd is woken up
3728 * when below the low watermark.
3729 */
3730 if (unlikely(!order && (alloc_flags & ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE) && z->watermark_boost
3731 && ((alloc_flags & ALLOC_WMARK_MASK) == WMARK_MIN))) {
3732 mark = z->_watermark[WMARK_MIN];
3733 return __zone_watermark_ok(z, order, mark, highest_zoneidx,
3734 alloc_flags, free_pages);
3735 }
3736
3737 return false;
3738}
3739
3740#ifdef CONFIG_NUMA
3741int __read_mostly node_reclaim_distance = RECLAIM_DISTANCE;
3742
3743static bool zone_allows_reclaim(struct zone *local_zone, struct zone *zone)
3744{
3745 return node_distance(zone_to_nid(local_zone), zone_to_nid(zone)) <=
3746 node_reclaim_distance;
3747}
3748#else /* CONFIG_NUMA */
3749static bool zone_allows_reclaim(struct zone *local_zone, struct zone *zone)
3750{
3751 return true;
3752}
3753#endif /* CONFIG_NUMA */
3754
3755/*
3756 * The restriction on ZONE_DMA32 as being a suitable zone to use to avoid
3757 * fragmentation is subtle. If the preferred zone was HIGHMEM then
3758 * premature use of a lower zone may cause lowmem pressure problems that
3759 * are worse than fragmentation. If the next zone is ZONE_DMA then it is
3760 * probably too small. It only makes sense to spread allocations to avoid
3761 * fragmentation between the Normal and DMA32 zones.
3762 */
3763static inline unsigned int
3764alloc_flags_nofragment(struct zone *zone, gfp_t gfp_mask)
3765{
3766 unsigned int alloc_flags;
3767
3768 /*
3769 * __GFP_KSWAPD_RECLAIM is assumed to be the same as ALLOC_KSWAPD
3770 * to save a branch.
3771 */
3772 alloc_flags = (__force int) (gfp_mask & __GFP_KSWAPD_RECLAIM);
3773
3774 if (defrag_mode) {
3775 alloc_flags |= ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT;
3776 return alloc_flags;
3777 }
3778
3779#ifdef CONFIG_ZONE_DMA32
3780 if (!zone)
3781 return alloc_flags;
3782
3783 if (zone_idx(zone) != ZONE_NORMAL)
3784 return alloc_flags;
3785
3786 /*
3787 * If ZONE_DMA32 exists, assume it is the one after ZONE_NORMAL and
3788 * the pointer is within zone->zone_pgdat->node_zones[]. Also assume
3789 * on UMA that if Normal is populated then so is DMA32.
3790 */
3791 BUILD_BUG_ON(ZONE_NORMAL - ZONE_DMA32 != 1);
3792 if (nr_online_nodes > 1 && !populated_zone(--zone))
3793 return alloc_flags;
3794
3795 alloc_flags |= ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT;
3796#endif /* CONFIG_ZONE_DMA32 */
3797 return alloc_flags;
3798}
3799
3800/* Must be called after current_gfp_context() which can change gfp_mask */
3801static inline unsigned int gfp_to_alloc_flags_cma(gfp_t gfp_mask,
3802 unsigned int alloc_flags)
3803{
3804#ifdef CONFIG_CMA
3805 if (gfp_migratetype(gfp_mask) == MIGRATE_MOVABLE)
3806 alloc_flags |= ALLOC_CMA;
3807#endif
3808 return alloc_flags;
3809}
3810
3811/*
3812 * get_page_from_freelist goes through the zonelist trying to allocate
3813 * a page.
3814 */
3815static struct page *
3816get_page_from_freelist(gfp_t gfp_mask, unsigned int order, int alloc_flags,
3817 const struct alloc_context *ac)
3818{
3819 struct zoneref *z;
3820 struct zone *zone;
3821 struct pglist_data *last_pgdat = NULL;
3822 bool last_pgdat_dirty_ok = false;
3823 bool no_fallback;
3824 bool skip_kswapd_nodes = nr_online_nodes > 1;
3825 bool skipped_kswapd_nodes = false;
3826
3827retry:
3828 /*
3829 * Scan zonelist, looking for a zone with enough free.
3830 * See also cpuset_current_node_allowed() comment in kernel/cgroup/cpuset.c.
3831 */
3832 no_fallback = alloc_flags & ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT;
3833 z = ac->preferred_zoneref;
3834 for_next_zone_zonelist_nodemask(zone, z, ac->highest_zoneidx,
3835 ac->nodemask) {
3836 struct page *page;
3837 unsigned long mark;
3838
3839 if (cpusets_enabled() &&
3840 (alloc_flags & ALLOC_CPUSET) &&
3841 !__cpuset_zone_allowed(zone, gfp_mask))
3842 continue;
3843 /*
3844 * When allocating a page cache page for writing, we
3845 * want to get it from a node that is within its dirty
3846 * limit, such that no single node holds more than its
3847 * proportional share of globally allowed dirty pages.
3848 * The dirty limits take into account the node's
3849 * lowmem reserves and high watermark so that kswapd
3850 * should be able to balance it without having to
3851 * write pages from its LRU list.
3852 *
3853 * XXX: For now, allow allocations to potentially
3854 * exceed the per-node dirty limit in the slowpath
3855 * (spread_dirty_pages unset) before going into reclaim,
3856 * which is important when on a NUMA setup the allowed
3857 * nodes are together not big enough to reach the
3858 * global limit. The proper fix for these situations
3859 * will require awareness of nodes in the
3860 * dirty-throttling and the flusher threads.
3861 */
3862 if (ac->spread_dirty_pages) {
3863 if (last_pgdat != zone->zone_pgdat) {
3864 last_pgdat = zone->zone_pgdat;
3865 last_pgdat_dirty_ok = node_dirty_ok(zone->zone_pgdat);
3866 }
3867
3868 if (!last_pgdat_dirty_ok)
3869 continue;
3870 }
3871
3872 if (no_fallback && !defrag_mode && nr_online_nodes > 1 &&
3873 zone != zonelist_zone(ac->preferred_zoneref)) {
3874 int local_nid;
3875
3876 /*
3877 * If moving to a remote node, retry but allow
3878 * fragmenting fallbacks. Locality is more important
3879 * than fragmentation avoidance.
3880 */
3881 local_nid = zonelist_node_idx(ac->preferred_zoneref);
3882 if (zone_to_nid(zone) != local_nid) {
3883 alloc_flags &= ~ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT;
3884 goto retry;
3885 }
3886 }
3887
3888 /*
3889 * If kswapd is already active on a node, keep looking
3890 * for other nodes that might be idle. This can happen
3891 * if another process has NUMA bindings and is causing
3892 * kswapd wakeups on only some nodes. Avoid accidental
3893 * "node_reclaim_mode"-like behavior in this case.
3894 */
3895 if (skip_kswapd_nodes &&
3896 !waitqueue_active(&zone->zone_pgdat->kswapd_wait)) {
3897 skipped_kswapd_nodes = true;
3898 continue;
3899 }
3900
3901 cond_accept_memory(zone, order, alloc_flags);
3902
3903 /*
3904 * Detect whether the number of free pages is below high
3905 * watermark. If so, we will decrease pcp->high and free
3906 * PCP pages in free path to reduce the possibility of
3907 * premature page reclaiming. Detection is done here to
3908 * avoid to do that in hotter free path.
3909 */
3910 if (test_bit(ZONE_BELOW_HIGH, &zone->flags))
3911 goto check_alloc_wmark;
3912
3913 mark = high_wmark_pages(zone);
3914 if (zone_watermark_fast(zone, order, mark,
3915 ac->highest_zoneidx, alloc_flags,
3916 gfp_mask))
3917 goto try_this_zone;
3918 else
3919 set_bit(ZONE_BELOW_HIGH, &zone->flags);
3920
3921check_alloc_wmark:
3922 mark = wmark_pages(zone, alloc_flags & ALLOC_WMARK_MASK);
3923 if (!zone_watermark_fast(zone, order, mark,
3924 ac->highest_zoneidx, alloc_flags,
3925 gfp_mask)) {
3926 int ret;
3927
3928 if (cond_accept_memory(zone, order, alloc_flags))
3929 goto try_this_zone;
3930
3931 /*
3932 * Watermark failed for this zone, but see if we can
3933 * grow this zone if it contains deferred pages.
3934 */
3935 if (deferred_pages_enabled()) {
3936 if (_deferred_grow_zone(zone, order))
3937 goto try_this_zone;
3938 }
3939 /* Checked here to keep the fast path fast */
3940 BUILD_BUG_ON(ALLOC_NO_WATERMARKS < NR_WMARK);
3941 if (alloc_flags & ALLOC_NO_WATERMARKS)
3942 goto try_this_zone;
3943
3944 if (!node_reclaim_enabled() ||
3945 !zone_allows_reclaim(zonelist_zone(ac->preferred_zoneref), zone))
3946 continue;
3947
3948 ret = node_reclaim(zone->zone_pgdat, gfp_mask, order);
3949 switch (ret) {
3950 case NODE_RECLAIM_NOSCAN:
3951 /* did not scan */
3952 continue;
3953 case NODE_RECLAIM_FULL:
3954 /* scanned but unreclaimable */
3955 continue;
3956 default:
3957 /* did we reclaim enough */
3958 if (zone_watermark_ok(zone, order, mark,
3959 ac->highest_zoneidx, alloc_flags))
3960 goto try_this_zone;
3961
3962 continue;
3963 }
3964 }
3965
3966try_this_zone:
3967 page = rmqueue(zonelist_zone(ac->preferred_zoneref), zone, order,
3968 gfp_mask, alloc_flags, ac->migratetype);
3969 if (page) {
3970 prep_new_page(page, order, gfp_mask, alloc_flags);
3971
3972 /*
3973 * If this is a high-order atomic allocation then check
3974 * if the pageblock should be reserved for the future
3975 */
3976 if (unlikely(alloc_flags & ALLOC_HIGHATOMIC))
3977 reserve_highatomic_pageblock(page, order, zone);
3978
3979 return page;
3980 } else {
3981 if (cond_accept_memory(zone, order, alloc_flags))
3982 goto try_this_zone;
3983
3984 /* Try again if zone has deferred pages */
3985 if (deferred_pages_enabled()) {
3986 if (_deferred_grow_zone(zone, order))
3987 goto try_this_zone;
3988 }
3989 }
3990 }
3991
3992 /*
3993 * If we skipped over nodes with active kswapds and found no
3994 * idle nodes, retry and place anywhere the watermarks permit.
3995 */
3996 if (skip_kswapd_nodes && skipped_kswapd_nodes) {
3997 skip_kswapd_nodes = false;
3998 goto retry;
3999 }
4000
4001 /*
4002 * It's possible on a UMA machine to get through all zones that are
4003 * fragmented. If avoiding fragmentation, reset and try again.
4004 */
4005 if (no_fallback && !defrag_mode) {
4006 alloc_flags &= ~ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT;
4007 goto retry;
4008 }
4009
4010 return NULL;
4011}
4012
4013static void warn_alloc_show_mem(gfp_t gfp_mask, nodemask_t *nodemask)
4014{
4015 unsigned int filter = SHOW_MEM_FILTER_NODES;
4016
4017 /*
4018 * This documents exceptions given to allocations in certain
4019 * contexts that are allowed to allocate outside current's set
4020 * of allowed nodes.
4021 */
4022 if (!(gfp_mask & __GFP_NOMEMALLOC))
4023 if (tsk_is_oom_victim(current) ||
4024 (current->flags & (PF_MEMALLOC | PF_EXITING)))
4025 filter &= ~SHOW_MEM_FILTER_NODES;
4026 if (!in_task() || !(gfp_mask & __GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM))
4027 filter &= ~SHOW_MEM_FILTER_NODES;
4028
4029 __show_mem(filter, nodemask, gfp_zone(gfp_mask));
4030 mem_cgroup_show_protected_memory(NULL);
4031}
4032
4033void warn_alloc(gfp_t gfp_mask, nodemask_t *nodemask, const char *fmt, ...)
4034{
4035 struct va_format vaf;
4036 va_list args;
4037 static DEFINE_RATELIMIT_STATE(nopage_rs, 10*HZ, 1);
4038
4039 if ((gfp_mask & __GFP_NOWARN) ||
4040 !__ratelimit(&nopage_rs) ||
4041 ((gfp_mask & __GFP_DMA) && !has_managed_dma()))
4042 return;
4043
4044 va_start(args, fmt);
4045 vaf.fmt = fmt;
4046 vaf.va = &args;
4047 pr_warn("%s: %pV, mode:%#x(%pGg), nodemask=%*pbl",
4048 current->comm, &vaf, gfp_mask, &gfp_mask,
4049 nodemask_pr_args(nodemask));
4050 va_end(args);
4051
4052 cpuset_print_current_mems_allowed();
4053 pr_cont("\n");
4054 dump_stack();
4055 warn_alloc_show_mem(gfp_mask, nodemask);
4056}
4057
4058static inline struct page *
4059__alloc_pages_cpuset_fallback(gfp_t gfp_mask, unsigned int order,
4060 unsigned int alloc_flags,
4061 const struct alloc_context *ac)
4062{
4063 struct page *page;
4064
4065 page = get_page_from_freelist(gfp_mask, order,
4066 alloc_flags|ALLOC_CPUSET, ac);
4067 /*
4068 * fallback to ignore cpuset restriction if our nodes
4069 * are depleted
4070 */
4071 if (!page)
4072 page = get_page_from_freelist(gfp_mask, order,
4073 alloc_flags, ac);
4074 return page;
4075}
4076
4077static inline struct page *
4078__alloc_pages_may_oom(gfp_t gfp_mask, unsigned int order,
4079 const struct alloc_context *ac, unsigned long *did_some_progress)
4080{
4081 struct oom_control oc = {
4082 .zonelist = ac->zonelist,
4083 .nodemask = ac->nodemask,
4084 .memcg = NULL,
4085 .gfp_mask = gfp_mask,
4086 .order = order,
4087 };
4088 struct page *page;
4089
4090 *did_some_progress = 0;
4091
4092 /*
4093 * Acquire the oom lock. If that fails, somebody else is
4094 * making progress for us.
4095 */
4096 if (!mutex_trylock(&oom_lock)) {
4097 *did_some_progress = 1;
4098 schedule_timeout_uninterruptible(1);
4099 return NULL;
4100 }
4101
4102 /*
4103 * Go through the zonelist yet one more time, keep very high watermark
4104 * here, this is only to catch a parallel oom killing, we must fail if
4105 * we're still under heavy pressure. But make sure that this reclaim
4106 * attempt shall not depend on __GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM && !__GFP_NORETRY
4107 * allocation which will never fail due to oom_lock already held.
4108 */
4109 page = get_page_from_freelist((gfp_mask | __GFP_HARDWALL) &
4110 ~__GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM, order,
4111 ALLOC_WMARK_HIGH|ALLOC_CPUSET, ac);
4112 if (page)
4113 goto out;
4114
4115 /* Coredumps can quickly deplete all memory reserves */
4116 if (current->flags & PF_DUMPCORE)
4117 goto out;
4118 /* The OOM killer will not help higher order allocs */
4119 if (order > PAGE_ALLOC_COSTLY_ORDER)
4120 goto out;
4121 /*
4122 * We have already exhausted all our reclaim opportunities without any
4123 * success so it is time to admit defeat. We will skip the OOM killer
4124 * because it is very likely that the caller has a more reasonable
4125 * fallback than shooting a random task.
4126 *
4127 * The OOM killer may not free memory on a specific node.
4128 */
4129 if (gfp_mask & (__GFP_RETRY_MAYFAIL | __GFP_THISNODE))
4130 goto out;
4131 /* The OOM killer does not needlessly kill tasks for lowmem */
4132 if (ac->highest_zoneidx < ZONE_NORMAL)
4133 goto out;
4134 if (pm_suspended_storage())
4135 goto out;
4136 /*
4137 * XXX: GFP_NOFS allocations should rather fail than rely on
4138 * other request to make a forward progress.
4139 * We are in an unfortunate situation where out_of_memory cannot
4140 * do much for this context but let's try it to at least get
4141 * access to memory reserved if the current task is killed (see
4142 * out_of_memory). Once filesystems are ready to handle allocation
4143 * failures more gracefully we should just bail out here.
4144 */
4145
4146 /* Exhausted what can be done so it's blame time */
4147 if (out_of_memory(&oc) ||
4148 WARN_ON_ONCE_GFP(gfp_mask & __GFP_NOFAIL, gfp_mask)) {
4149 *did_some_progress = 1;
4150
4151 /*
4152 * Help non-failing allocations by giving them access to memory
4153 * reserves
4154 */
4155 if (gfp_mask & __GFP_NOFAIL)
4156 page = __alloc_pages_cpuset_fallback(gfp_mask, order,
4157 ALLOC_NO_WATERMARKS, ac);
4158 }
4159out:
4160 mutex_unlock(&oom_lock);
4161 return page;
4162}
4163
4164/*
4165 * Maximum number of compaction retries with a progress before OOM
4166 * killer is consider as the only way to move forward.
4167 */
4168#define MAX_COMPACT_RETRIES 16
4169
4170#ifdef CONFIG_COMPACTION
4171/* Try memory compaction for high-order allocations before reclaim */
4172static struct page *
4173__alloc_pages_direct_compact(gfp_t gfp_mask, unsigned int order,
4174 unsigned int alloc_flags, const struct alloc_context *ac,
4175 enum compact_priority prio, enum compact_result *compact_result)
4176{
4177 struct page *page = NULL;
4178 unsigned long pflags;
4179 unsigned int noreclaim_flag;
4180
4181 if (!order)
4182 return NULL;
4183
4184 psi_memstall_enter(&pflags);
4185 delayacct_compact_start();
4186 noreclaim_flag = memalloc_noreclaim_save();
4187
4188 *compact_result = try_to_compact_pages(gfp_mask, order, alloc_flags, ac,
4189 prio, &page);
4190
4191 memalloc_noreclaim_restore(noreclaim_flag);
4192 psi_memstall_leave(&pflags);
4193 delayacct_compact_end();
4194
4195 if (*compact_result == COMPACT_SKIPPED)
4196 return NULL;
4197 /*
4198 * At least in one zone compaction wasn't deferred or skipped, so let's
4199 * count a compaction stall
4200 */
4201 count_vm_event(COMPACTSTALL);
4202
4203 /* Prep a captured page if available */
4204 if (page)
4205 prep_new_page(page, order, gfp_mask, alloc_flags);
4206
4207 /* Try get a page from the freelist if available */
4208 if (!page)
4209 page = get_page_from_freelist(gfp_mask, order, alloc_flags, ac);
4210
4211 if (page) {
4212 struct zone *zone = page_zone(page);
4213
4214 zone->compact_blockskip_flush = false;
4215 compaction_defer_reset(zone, order, true);
4216 count_vm_event(COMPACTSUCCESS);
4217 return page;
4218 }
4219
4220 /*
4221 * It's bad if compaction run occurs and fails. The most likely reason
4222 * is that pages exist, but not enough to satisfy watermarks.
4223 */
4224 count_vm_event(COMPACTFAIL);
4225
4226 cond_resched();
4227
4228 return NULL;
4229}
4230
4231static inline bool
4232should_compact_retry(struct alloc_context *ac, int order, int alloc_flags,
4233 enum compact_result compact_result,
4234 enum compact_priority *compact_priority,
4235 int *compaction_retries)
4236{
4237 int max_retries = MAX_COMPACT_RETRIES;
4238 int min_priority;
4239 bool ret = false;
4240 int retries = *compaction_retries;
4241 enum compact_priority priority = *compact_priority;
4242
4243 if (!order)
4244 return false;
4245
4246 if (fatal_signal_pending(current))
4247 return false;
4248
4249 /*
4250 * Compaction was skipped due to a lack of free order-0
4251 * migration targets. Continue if reclaim can help.
4252 */
4253 if (compact_result == COMPACT_SKIPPED) {
4254 ret = compaction_zonelist_suitable(ac, order, alloc_flags);
4255 goto out;
4256 }
4257
4258 /*
4259 * Compaction managed to coalesce some page blocks, but the
4260 * allocation failed presumably due to a race. Retry some.
4261 */
4262 if (compact_result == COMPACT_SUCCESS) {
4263 /*
4264 * !costly requests are much more important than
4265 * __GFP_RETRY_MAYFAIL costly ones because they are de
4266 * facto nofail and invoke OOM killer to move on while
4267 * costly can fail and users are ready to cope with
4268 * that. 1/4 retries is rather arbitrary but we would
4269 * need much more detailed feedback from compaction to
4270 * make a better decision.
4271 */
4272 if (order > PAGE_ALLOC_COSTLY_ORDER)
4273 max_retries /= 4;
4274
4275 if (++(*compaction_retries) <= max_retries) {
4276 ret = true;
4277 goto out;
4278 }
4279 }
4280
4281 /*
4282 * Compaction failed. Retry with increasing priority.
4283 */
4284 min_priority = (order > PAGE_ALLOC_COSTLY_ORDER) ?
4285 MIN_COMPACT_COSTLY_PRIORITY : MIN_COMPACT_PRIORITY;
4286
4287 if (*compact_priority > min_priority) {
4288 (*compact_priority)--;
4289 *compaction_retries = 0;
4290 ret = true;
4291 }
4292out:
4293 trace_compact_retry(order, priority, compact_result, retries, max_retries, ret);
4294 return ret;
4295}
4296#else
4297static inline struct page *
4298__alloc_pages_direct_compact(gfp_t gfp_mask, unsigned int order,
4299 unsigned int alloc_flags, const struct alloc_context *ac,
4300 enum compact_priority prio, enum compact_result *compact_result)
4301{
4302 *compact_result = COMPACT_SKIPPED;
4303 return NULL;
4304}
4305
4306static inline bool
4307should_compact_retry(struct alloc_context *ac, int order, int alloc_flags,
4308 enum compact_result compact_result,
4309 enum compact_priority *compact_priority,
4310 int *compaction_retries)
4311{
4312 struct zone *zone;
4313 struct zoneref *z;
4314
4315 if (!order || order > PAGE_ALLOC_COSTLY_ORDER)
4316 return false;
4317
4318 /*
4319 * There are setups with compaction disabled which would prefer to loop
4320 * inside the allocator rather than hit the oom killer prematurely.
4321 * Let's give them a good hope and keep retrying while the order-0
4322 * watermarks are OK.
4323 */
4324 for_each_zone_zonelist_nodemask(zone, z, ac->zonelist,
4325 ac->highest_zoneidx, ac->nodemask) {
4326 if (zone_watermark_ok(zone, 0, min_wmark_pages(zone),
4327 ac->highest_zoneidx, alloc_flags))
4328 return true;
4329 }
4330 return false;
4331}
4332#endif /* CONFIG_COMPACTION */
4333
4334#ifdef CONFIG_LOCKDEP
4335static struct lockdep_map __fs_reclaim_map =
4336 STATIC_LOCKDEP_MAP_INIT("fs_reclaim", &__fs_reclaim_map);
4337
4338static bool __need_reclaim(gfp_t gfp_mask)
4339{
4340 /* no reclaim without waiting on it */
4341 if (!(gfp_mask & __GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM))
4342 return false;
4343
4344 /* this guy won't enter reclaim */
4345 if (current->flags & PF_MEMALLOC)
4346 return false;
4347
4348 if (gfp_mask & __GFP_NOLOCKDEP)
4349 return false;
4350
4351 return true;
4352}
4353
4354void __fs_reclaim_acquire(unsigned long ip)
4355{
4356 lock_acquire_exclusive(&__fs_reclaim_map, 0, 0, NULL, ip);
4357}
4358
4359void __fs_reclaim_release(unsigned long ip)
4360{
4361 lock_release(&__fs_reclaim_map, ip);
4362}
4363
4364void fs_reclaim_acquire(gfp_t gfp_mask)
4365{
4366 gfp_mask = current_gfp_context(gfp_mask);
4367
4368 if (__need_reclaim(gfp_mask)) {
4369 if (gfp_mask & __GFP_FS)
4370 __fs_reclaim_acquire(_RET_IP_);
4371
4372#ifdef CONFIG_MMU_NOTIFIER
4373 lock_map_acquire(&__mmu_notifier_invalidate_range_start_map);
4374 lock_map_release(&__mmu_notifier_invalidate_range_start_map);
4375#endif
4376
4377 }
4378}
4379EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(fs_reclaim_acquire);
4380
4381void fs_reclaim_release(gfp_t gfp_mask)
4382{
4383 gfp_mask = current_gfp_context(gfp_mask);
4384
4385 if (__need_reclaim(gfp_mask)) {
4386 if (gfp_mask & __GFP_FS)
4387 __fs_reclaim_release(_RET_IP_);
4388 }
4389}
4390EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(fs_reclaim_release);
4391#endif
