4393/*
4394 * Zonelists may change due to hotplug during allocation. Detect when zonelists
4395 * have been rebuilt so allocation retries. Reader side does not lock and
4396 * retries the allocation if zonelist changes. Writer side is protected by the
4397 * embedded spin_lock.
4398 */
4399static DEFINE_SEQLOCK(zonelist_update_seq);
4400
4401static unsigned int zonelist_iter_begin(void)
4402{
4403 if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_MEMORY_HOTREMOVE))
4404 return read_seqbegin(&zonelist_update_seq);
4405
4406 return 0;
4407}
4408
4409static unsigned int check_retry_zonelist(unsigned int seq)
4410{
4411 if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_MEMORY_HOTREMOVE))
4412 return read_seqretry(&zonelist_update_seq, seq);
4413
4414 return seq;
4415}
4416
4417/* Perform direct synchronous page reclaim */
4418static unsigned long
4419__perform_reclaim(gfp_t gfp_mask, unsigned int order,
4420 const struct alloc_context *ac)
4421{
4422 unsigned int noreclaim_flag;
4423 unsigned long progress;
4424
4425 cond_resched();
4426
4427 /* We now go into synchronous reclaim */
4428 cpuset_memory_pressure_bump();
4429 fs_reclaim_acquire(gfp_mask);
4430 noreclaim_flag = memalloc_noreclaim_save();
4431
4432 progress = try_to_free_pages(ac->zonelist, order, gfp_mask,
4433 ac->nodemask);
4434
4435 memalloc_noreclaim_restore(noreclaim_flag);
4436 fs_reclaim_release(gfp_mask);
4437
4438 cond_resched();
4439
4440 return progress;
4441}
4442
4443/* The really slow allocator path where we enter direct reclaim */
4444static inline struct page *
4445__alloc_pages_direct_reclaim(gfp_t gfp_mask, unsigned int order,
4446 unsigned int alloc_flags, const struct alloc_context *ac,
4447 unsigned long *did_some_progress)
4448{
4449 struct page *page = NULL;
4450 unsigned long pflags;
4451 bool drained = false;
4452
4453 psi_memstall_enter(&pflags);
4454 *did_some_progress = __perform_reclaim(gfp_mask, order, ac);
4455 if (unlikely(!(*did_some_progress)))
4456 goto out;
4457
4458retry:
4459 page = get_page_from_freelist(gfp_mask, order, alloc_flags, ac);
4460
4461 /*
4462 * If an allocation failed after direct reclaim, it could be because
4463 * pages are pinned on the per-cpu lists or in high alloc reserves.
4464 * Shrink them and try again
4465 */
4466 if (!page && !drained) {
4467 unreserve_highatomic_pageblock(ac, false);
4468 drain_all_pages(NULL);
4469 drained = true;
4470 goto retry;
4471 }
4472out:
4473 psi_memstall_leave(&pflags);
4474
4475 return page;
4476}
4477
4478static void wake_all_kswapds(unsigned int order, gfp_t gfp_mask,
4479 const struct alloc_context *ac)
4480{
4481 struct zoneref *z;
4482 struct zone *zone;
4483 pg_data_t *last_pgdat = NULL;
4484 enum zone_type highest_zoneidx = ac->highest_zoneidx;
4485 unsigned int reclaim_order;
4486
4487 if (defrag_mode)
4488 reclaim_order = max(order, pageblock_order);
4489 else
4490 reclaim_order = order;
4491
4492 for_each_zone_zonelist_nodemask(zone, z, ac->zonelist, highest_zoneidx,
4493 ac->nodemask) {
4494 if (!managed_zone(zone))
4495 continue;
4496 if (last_pgdat == zone->zone_pgdat)
4497 continue;
4498 wakeup_kswapd(zone, gfp_mask, reclaim_order, highest_zoneidx);
4499 last_pgdat = zone->zone_pgdat;
4500 }
4501}
4502
4503static inline unsigned int
4504gfp_to_alloc_flags(gfp_t gfp_mask, unsigned int order)
4505{
4506 unsigned int alloc_flags = ALLOC_WMARK_MIN | ALLOC_CPUSET;
4507
4508 /*
4509 * __GFP_HIGH is assumed to be the same as ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE
4510 * and __GFP_KSWAPD_RECLAIM is assumed to be the same as ALLOC_KSWAPD
4511 * to save two branches.
4512 */
4513 BUILD_BUG_ON(__GFP_HIGH != (__force gfp_t) ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE);
4514 BUILD_BUG_ON(__GFP_KSWAPD_RECLAIM != (__force gfp_t) ALLOC_KSWAPD);
4515
4516 /*
4517 * The caller may dip into page reserves a bit more if the caller
4518 * cannot run direct reclaim, or if the caller has realtime scheduling
4519 * policy or is asking for __GFP_HIGH memory. GFP_ATOMIC requests will
4520 * set both ALLOC_NON_BLOCK and ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE(__GFP_HIGH).
4521 */
4522 alloc_flags |= (__force int)
4523 (gfp_mask & (__GFP_HIGH | __GFP_KSWAPD_RECLAIM));
4524
4525 if (!(gfp_mask & __GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM)) {
4526 /*
4527 * Not worth trying to allocate harder for __GFP_NOMEMALLOC even
4528 * if it can't schedule.
4529 */
4530 if (!(gfp_mask & __GFP_NOMEMALLOC)) {
4531 alloc_flags |= ALLOC_NON_BLOCK;
4532
4533 if (order > 0 && (alloc_flags & ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE))
4534 alloc_flags |= ALLOC_HIGHATOMIC;
4535 }
4536
4537 /*
4538 * Ignore cpuset mems for non-blocking __GFP_HIGH (probably
4539 * GFP_ATOMIC) rather than fail, see the comment for
4540 * cpuset_current_node_allowed().
4541 */
4542 if (alloc_flags & ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE)
4543 alloc_flags &= ~ALLOC_CPUSET;
4544 } else if (unlikely(rt_or_dl_task(current)) && in_task())
4545 alloc_flags |= ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE;
4546
4547 alloc_flags = gfp_to_alloc_flags_cma(gfp_mask, alloc_flags);
4548
4549 if (defrag_mode)
4550 alloc_flags |= ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT;
4551
4552 return alloc_flags;
4553}
4554
4555static bool oom_reserves_allowed(struct task_struct *tsk)
4556{
4557 if (!tsk_is_oom_victim(tsk))
4558 return false;
4559
4560 /*
4561 * !MMU doesn't have oom reaper so give access to memory reserves
4562 * only to the thread with TIF_MEMDIE set
4563 */
4564 if (!IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_MMU) && !test_thread_flag(TIF_MEMDIE))
4565 return false;
4566
4567 return true;
4568}
4569
4570/*
4571 * Distinguish requests which really need access to full memory
4572 * reserves from oom victims which can live with a portion of it
4573 */
4574static inline int __gfp_pfmemalloc_flags(gfp_t gfp_mask)
4575{
4576 if (unlikely(gfp_mask & __GFP_NOMEMALLOC))
4577 return 0;
4578 if (gfp_mask & __GFP_MEMALLOC)
4579 return ALLOC_NO_WATERMARKS;
4580 if (in_serving_softirq() && (current->flags & PF_MEMALLOC))
4581 return ALLOC_NO_WATERMARKS;
4582 if (!in_interrupt()) {
4583 if (current->flags & PF_MEMALLOC)
4584 return ALLOC_NO_WATERMARKS;
4585 else if (oom_reserves_allowed(current))
4586 return ALLOC_OOM;
4587 }
4588
4589 return 0;
4590}
4591
4592bool gfp_pfmemalloc_allowed(gfp_t gfp_mask)
4593{
4594 return !!__gfp_pfmemalloc_flags(gfp_mask);
4595}
4596
4597/*
4598 * Checks whether it makes sense to retry the reclaim to make a forward progress
4599 * for the given allocation request.
4600 *
4601 * We give up when we either have tried MAX_RECLAIM_RETRIES in a row
4602 * without success, or when we couldn't even meet the watermark if we
4603 * reclaimed all remaining pages on the LRU lists.
4604 *
4605 * Returns true if a retry is viable or false to enter the oom path.
4606 */
4607static inline bool
4608should_reclaim_retry(gfp_t gfp_mask, unsigned order,
4609 struct alloc_context *ac, int alloc_flags,
4610 bool did_some_progress, int *no_progress_loops)
4611{
4612 struct zone *zone;
4613 struct zoneref *z;
4614 bool ret = false;
4615
4616 /*
4617 * Costly allocations might have made a progress but this doesn't mean
4618 * their order will become available due to high fragmentation so
4619 * always increment the no progress counter for them
4620 */
4621 if (did_some_progress && order <= PAGE_ALLOC_COSTLY_ORDER)
4622 *no_progress_loops = 0;
4623 else
4624 (*no_progress_loops)++;
4625
4626 if (*no_progress_loops > MAX_RECLAIM_RETRIES)
4627 goto out;
4628
4629
4630 /*
4631 * Keep reclaiming pages while there is a chance this will lead
4632 * somewhere. If none of the target zones can satisfy our allocation
4633 * request even if all reclaimable pages are considered then we are
4634 * screwed and have to go OOM.
4635 */
4636 for_each_zone_zonelist_nodemask(zone, z, ac->zonelist,
4637 ac->highest_zoneidx, ac->nodemask) {
4638 unsigned long available;
4639 unsigned long reclaimable;
4640 unsigned long min_wmark = min_wmark_pages(zone);
4641 bool wmark;
4642
4643 if (cpusets_enabled() &&
4644 (alloc_flags & ALLOC_CPUSET) &&
4645 !__cpuset_zone_allowed(zone, gfp_mask))
4646 continue;
4647
4648 available = reclaimable = zone_reclaimable_pages(zone);
4649 available += zone_page_state_snapshot(zone, NR_FREE_PAGES);
4650
4651 /*
4652 * Would the allocation succeed if we reclaimed all
4653 * reclaimable pages?
4654 */
4655 wmark = __zone_watermark_ok(zone, order, min_wmark,
4656 ac->highest_zoneidx, alloc_flags, available);
4657 trace_reclaim_retry_zone(z, order, reclaimable,
4658 available, min_wmark, *no_progress_loops, wmark);
4659 if (wmark) {
4660 ret = true;
4661 break;
4662 }
4663 }
4664
4665 /*
4666 * Memory allocation/reclaim might be called from a WQ context and the
4667 * current implementation of the WQ concurrency control doesn't
4668 * recognize that a particular WQ is congested if the worker thread is
4669 * looping without ever sleeping. Therefore we have to do a short sleep
4670 * here rather than calling cond_resched().
4671 */
4672 if (current->flags & PF_WQ_WORKER)
4673 schedule_timeout_uninterruptible(1);
4674 else
4675 cond_resched();
4676out:
4677 /* Before OOM, exhaust highatomic_reserve */
4678 if (!ret)
4679 return unreserve_highatomic_pageblock(ac, true);
4680
4681 return ret;
4682}
4683
4684static inline bool
4685check_retry_cpuset(int cpuset_mems_cookie, struct alloc_context *ac)
4686{
4687 /*
4688 * It's possible that cpuset's mems_allowed and the nodemask from
4689 * mempolicy don't intersect. This should be normally dealt with by
4690 * policy_nodemask(), but it's possible to race with cpuset update in
4691 * such a way the check therein was true, and then it became false
4692 * before we got our cpuset_mems_cookie here.
4693 * This assumes that for all allocations, ac->nodemask can come only
4694 * from MPOL_BIND mempolicy (whose documented semantics is to be ignored
4695 * when it does not intersect with the cpuset restrictions) or the
4696 * caller can deal with a violated nodemask.
4697 */
4698 if (cpusets_enabled() && ac->nodemask &&
4699 !cpuset_nodemask_valid_mems_allowed(ac->nodemask)) {
4700 ac->nodemask = NULL;
4701 return true;
4702 }
4703
4704 /*
4705 * When updating a task's mems_allowed or mempolicy nodemask, it is
4706 * possible to race with parallel threads in such a way that our
4707 * allocation can fail while the mask is being updated. If we are about
4708 * to fail, check if the cpuset changed during allocation and if so,
4709 * retry.
4710 */
4711 if (read_mems_allowed_retry(cpuset_mems_cookie))
4712 return true;
4713
4714 return false;
4715}
4716
4717static inline struct page *
4718__alloc_pages_slowpath(gfp_t gfp_mask, unsigned int order,
4719 struct alloc_context *ac)
4720{
4721 bool can_direct_reclaim = gfp_mask & __GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM;
4722 bool can_compact = can_direct_reclaim && gfp_compaction_allowed(gfp_mask);
4723 bool nofail = gfp_mask & __GFP_NOFAIL;
4724 const bool costly_order = order > PAGE_ALLOC_COSTLY_ORDER;
4725 struct page *page = NULL;
4726 unsigned int alloc_flags;
4727 unsigned long did_some_progress;
4728 enum compact_priority compact_priority;
4729 enum compact_result compact_result;
4730 int compaction_retries;
4731 int no_progress_loops;
4732 unsigned int cpuset_mems_cookie;
4733 unsigned int zonelist_iter_cookie;
4734 int reserve_flags;
4735 bool compact_first = false;
4736 bool can_retry_reserves = true;
4737
4738 if (unlikely(nofail)) {
4739 /*
4740 * Also we don't support __GFP_NOFAIL without __GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM,
4741 * otherwise, we may result in lockup.
4742 */
4743 WARN_ON_ONCE(!can_direct_reclaim);
4744 /*
4745 * PF_MEMALLOC request from this context is rather bizarre
4746 * because we cannot reclaim anything and only can loop waiting
4747 * for somebody to do a work for us.
4748 */
4749 WARN_ON_ONCE(current->flags & PF_MEMALLOC);
4750 }
4751
4752restart:
4753 compaction_retries = 0;
4754 no_progress_loops = 0;
4755 compact_result = COMPACT_SKIPPED;
4756 compact_priority = DEF_COMPACT_PRIORITY;
4757 cpuset_mems_cookie = read_mems_allowed_begin();
4758 zonelist_iter_cookie = zonelist_iter_begin();
4759
4760 /*
4761 * For costly allocations, try direct compaction first, as it's likely
4762 * that we have enough base pages and don't need to reclaim. For non-
4763 * movable high-order allocations, do that as well, as compaction will
4764 * try prevent permanent fragmentation by migrating from blocks of the
4765 * same migratetype.
4766 */
4767 if (can_compact && (costly_order || (order > 0 &&
4768 ac->migratetype != MIGRATE_MOVABLE))) {
4769 compact_first = true;
4770 compact_priority = INIT_COMPACT_PRIORITY;
4771 }
4772
4773 /*
4774 * The fast path uses conservative alloc_flags to succeed only until
4775 * kswapd needs to be woken up, and to avoid the cost of setting up
4776 * alloc_flags precisely. So we do that now.
4777 */
4778 alloc_flags = gfp_to_alloc_flags(gfp_mask, order);
4779
4780 /*
4781 * We need to recalculate the starting point for the zonelist iterator
4782 * because we might have used different nodemask in the fast path, or
4783 * there was a cpuset modification and we are retrying - otherwise we
4784 * could end up iterating over non-eligible zones endlessly.
4785 */
4786 ac->preferred_zoneref = first_zones_zonelist(ac->zonelist,
4787 ac->highest_zoneidx, ac->nodemask);
4788 if (!zonelist_zone(ac->preferred_zoneref))
4789 goto nopage;
4790
4791 /*
4792 * Check for insane configurations where the cpuset doesn't contain
4793 * any suitable zone to satisfy the request - e.g. non-movable
4794 * GFP_HIGHUSER allocations from MOVABLE nodes only.
4795 */
4796 if (cpusets_insane_config() && (gfp_mask & __GFP_HARDWALL)) {
4797 struct zoneref *z = first_zones_zonelist(ac->zonelist,
4798 ac->highest_zoneidx,
4799 &cpuset_current_mems_allowed);
4800 if (!zonelist_zone(z))
4801 goto nopage;
4802 }
4803
4804retry:
4805 /* Ensure kswapd doesn't accidentally go to sleep as long as we loop */
4806 if (alloc_flags & ALLOC_KSWAPD)
4807 wake_all_kswapds(order, gfp_mask, ac);
4808
4809 /*
4810 * The adjusted alloc_flags might result in immediate success, so try
4811 * that first
4812 */
4813 page = get_page_from_freelist(gfp_mask, order, alloc_flags, ac);
4814 if (page)
4815 goto got_pg;
4816
4817 reserve_flags = __gfp_pfmemalloc_flags(gfp_mask);
4818 if (reserve_flags)
4819 alloc_flags = gfp_to_alloc_flags_cma(gfp_mask, reserve_flags) |
4820 (alloc_flags & ALLOC_KSWAPD);
4821
4822 /*
4823 * Reset the nodemask and zonelist iterators if memory policies can be
4824 * ignored. These allocations are high priority and system rather than
4825 * user oriented.
4826 */
4827 if (!(alloc_flags & ALLOC_CPUSET) || reserve_flags) {
4828 ac->nodemask = NULL;
4829 ac->preferred_zoneref = first_zones_zonelist(ac->zonelist,
4830 ac->highest_zoneidx, ac->nodemask);
4831
4832 /*
4833 * The first time we adjust anything due to being allowed to
4834 * ignore memory policies or watermarks, retry immediately. This
4835 * allows us to keep the first allocation attempt optimistic so
4836 * it can succeed in a zone that is still above watermarks.
4837 */
4838 if (can_retry_reserves) {
4839 can_retry_reserves = false;
4840 goto retry;
4841 }
4842 }
4843
4844 /* Caller is not willing to reclaim, we can't balance anything */
4845 if (!can_direct_reclaim)
4846 goto nopage;
4847
4848 /* Avoid recursion of direct reclaim */
4849 if (current->flags & PF_MEMALLOC)
4850 goto nopage;
4851
4852 /* Try direct reclaim and then allocating */
4853 if (!compact_first) {
4854 page = __alloc_pages_direct_reclaim(gfp_mask, order, alloc_flags,
4855 ac, &did_some_progress);
4856 if (page)
4857 goto got_pg;
4858 }
4859
4860 /* Try direct compaction and then allocating */
4861 page = __alloc_pages_direct_compact(gfp_mask, order, alloc_flags, ac,
4862 compact_priority, &compact_result);
4863 if (page)
4864 goto got_pg;
4865
4866 if (compact_first) {
4867 /*
4868 * THP page faults may attempt local node only first, but are
4869 * then allowed to only compact, not reclaim, see
4870 * alloc_pages_mpol().
4871 *
4872 * Compaction has failed above and we don't want such THP
4873 * allocations to put reclaim pressure on a single node in a
4874 * situation where other nodes might have plenty of available
4875 * memory.
4876 */
4877 if (gfp_has_flags(gfp_mask, __GFP_NORETRY | __GFP_THISNODE))
4878 goto nopage;
4879
4880 /*
4881 * For the initial compaction attempt we have lowered its
4882 * priority. Restore it for further retries, if those are
4883 * allowed. With __GFP_NORETRY there will be a single round of
4884 * reclaim and compaction with the lowered priority.
4885 */
4886 if (!(gfp_mask & __GFP_NORETRY))
4887 compact_priority = DEF_COMPACT_PRIORITY;
4888
4889 compact_first = false;
4890 goto retry;
4891 }
4892
4893 /* Do not loop if specifically requested */
4894 if (gfp_mask & __GFP_NORETRY)
4895 goto nopage;
4896
4897 /*
4898 * Do not retry costly high order allocations unless they are
4899 * __GFP_RETRY_MAYFAIL and we can compact
4900 */
4901 if (costly_order && (!can_compact ||
4902 !(gfp_mask & __GFP_RETRY_MAYFAIL)))
4903 goto nopage;
4904
4905 /*
4906 * Deal with possible cpuset update races or zonelist updates to avoid
4907 * infinite retries. No "goto retry;" can be placed above this check
4908 * unless it can execute just once.
4909 */
4910 if (check_retry_cpuset(cpuset_mems_cookie, ac) ||
4911 check_retry_zonelist(zonelist_iter_cookie))
4912 goto restart;
4913
4914 if (should_reclaim_retry(gfp_mask, order, ac, alloc_flags,
4915 did_some_progress > 0, &no_progress_loops))
4916 goto retry;
4917
4918 /*
4919 * It doesn't make any sense to retry for the compaction if the order-0
4920 * reclaim is not able to make any progress because the current
4921 * implementation of the compaction depends on the sufficient amount
4922 * of free memory (see __compaction_suitable)
4923 */
4924 if (did_some_progress > 0 && can_compact &&
4925 should_compact_retry(ac, order, alloc_flags,
4926 compact_result, &compact_priority,
4927 &compaction_retries))
4928 goto retry;
4929
4930 /* Reclaim/compaction failed to prevent the fallback */
4931 if (defrag_mode && (alloc_flags & ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT)) {
4932 alloc_flags &= ~ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT;
4933 goto retry;
4934 }
4935
4936 /*
4937 * Deal with possible cpuset update races or zonelist updates to avoid
4938 * a unnecessary OOM kill.
4939 */
4940 if (check_retry_cpuset(cpuset_mems_cookie, ac) ||
4941 check_retry_zonelist(zonelist_iter_cookie))
4942 goto restart;
4943
4944 /* Reclaim has failed us, start killing things */
4945 page = __alloc_pages_may_oom(gfp_mask, order, ac, &did_some_progress);
4946 if (page)
4947 goto got_pg;
4948
4949 /* Avoid allocations with no watermarks from looping endlessly */
4950 if (tsk_is_oom_victim(current) &&
4951 (alloc_flags & ALLOC_OOM ||
4952 (gfp_mask & __GFP_NOMEMALLOC)))
4953 goto nopage;
4954
4955 /* Retry as long as the OOM killer is making progress */
4956 if (did_some_progress) {
4957 no_progress_loops = 0;
4958 goto retry;
4959 }
4960
4961nopage:
4962 /*
4963 * Deal with possible cpuset update races or zonelist updates to avoid
4964 * a unnecessary OOM kill.
4965 */
4966 if (check_retry_cpuset(cpuset_mems_cookie, ac) ||
4967 check_retry_zonelist(zonelist_iter_cookie))
4968 goto restart;
4969
4970 /*
4971 * Make sure that __GFP_NOFAIL request doesn't leak out and make sure
4972 * we always retry
4973 */
4974 if (unlikely(nofail)) {
4975 /*
4976 * Lacking direct_reclaim we can't do anything to reclaim memory,
4977 * we disregard these unreasonable nofail requests and still
4978 * return NULL
4979 */
4980 if (!can_direct_reclaim)
4981 goto fail;
4982
4983 /*
4984 * Help non-failing allocations by giving some access to memory
4985 * reserves normally used for high priority non-blocking
4986 * allocations but do not use ALLOC_NO_WATERMARKS because this
4987 * could deplete whole memory reserves which would just make
4988 * the situation worse.
4989 */
4990 page = __alloc_pages_cpuset_fallback(gfp_mask, order, ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE, ac);
4991 if (page)
4992 goto got_pg;
4993
4994 cond_resched();
4995 goto retry;
4996 }
4997fail:
4998 warn_alloc(gfp_mask, ac->nodemask,
4999 "page allocation failure: order:%u", order);
5000got_pg:
5001 return page;
5002}
5003
5004static inline bool prepare_alloc_pages(gfp_t gfp_mask, unsigned int order,
5005 int preferred_nid, nodemask_t *nodemask,
5006 struct alloc_context *ac, gfp_t *alloc_gfp,
5007 unsigned int *alloc_flags)
5008{
5009 ac->highest_zoneidx = gfp_zone(gfp_mask);
5010 ac->zonelist = node_zonelist(preferred_nid, gfp_mask);
5011 ac->nodemask = nodemask;
5012 ac->migratetype = gfp_migratetype(gfp_mask);
5013
5014 if (cpusets_enabled()) {
5015 *alloc_gfp |= __GFP_HARDWALL;
5016 /*
5017 * When we are in the interrupt context, it is irrelevant
5018 * to the current task context. It means that any node ok.
5019 */
5020 if (in_task() && !ac->nodemask)
5021 ac->nodemask = &cpuset_current_mems_allowed;
5022 else
5023 *alloc_flags |= ALLOC_CPUSET;
5024 }
5025
5026 might_alloc(gfp_mask);
5027
5028 /*
5029 * Don't invoke should_fail logic, since it may call
5030 * get_random_u32() and printk() which need to spin_lock.
5031 */
5032 if (!(*alloc_flags & ALLOC_TRYLOCK) &&
5033 should_fail_alloc_page(gfp_mask, order))
5034 return false;
5035
5036 *alloc_flags = gfp_to_alloc_flags_cma(gfp_mask, *alloc_flags);
5037
5038 /* Dirty zone balancing only done in the fast path */
5039 ac->spread_dirty_pages = (gfp_mask & __GFP_WRITE);
5040
5041 /*
5042 * The preferred zone is used for statistics but crucially it is
5043 * also used as the starting point for the zonelist iterator. It
5044 * may get reset for allocations that ignore memory policies.
5045 */
5046 ac->preferred_zoneref = first_zones_zonelist(ac->zonelist,
5047 ac->highest_zoneidx, ac->nodemask);
5048
5049 return true;
5050}
5051
5052/*
5053 * __alloc_pages_bulk - Allocate a number of order-0 pages to an array
5054 * @gfp: GFP flags for the allocation
5055 * @preferred_nid: The preferred NUMA node ID to allocate from
5056 * @nodemask: Set of nodes to allocate from, may be NULL
5057 * @nr_pages: The number of pages desired in the array
5058 * @page_array: Array to store the pages
5059 *
5060 * This is a batched version of the page allocator that attempts to allocate
5061 * @nr_pages quickly. Pages are added to @page_array.
5062 *
5063 * Note that only the elements in @page_array that were cleared to %NULL on
5064 * entry are populated with newly allocated pages. @nr_pages is the maximum
5065 * number of pages that will be stored in the array.
5066 *
5067 * Returns the number of pages in @page_array, including ones already
5068 * allocated on entry. This can be less than the number requested in @nr_pages,
5069 * but all empty slots are filled from the beginning. I.e., if all slots in
5070 * @page_array were set to %NULL on entry, the slots from 0 to the return value
5071 * - 1 will be filled.
5072 */
5073unsigned long alloc_pages_bulk_noprof(gfp_t gfp, int preferred_nid,
5074 nodemask_t *nodemask, int nr_pages,
5075 struct page **page_array)
5076{
5077 struct page *page;
5078 unsigned long UP_flags;
5079 struct zone *zone;
5080 struct zoneref *z;
5081 struct per_cpu_pages *pcp;
5082 struct list_head *pcp_list;
5083 struct alloc_context ac;
5084 gfp_t alloc_gfp;
5085 unsigned int alloc_flags = ALLOC_WMARK_LOW;
5086 int nr_populated = 0, nr_account = 0;
5087
5088 /*
5089 * Skip populated array elements to determine if any pages need
5090 * to be allocated before disabling IRQs.
5091 */
5092 while (nr_populated < nr_pages && page_array[nr_populated])
5093 nr_populated++;
5094
5095 /* No pages requested? */
5096 if (unlikely(nr_pages <= 0))
5097 goto out;
5098
5099 /* Already populated array? */
5100 if (unlikely(nr_pages - nr_populated == 0))
5101 goto out;
5102
5103 /* Bulk allocator does not support memcg accounting. */
5104 if (memcg_kmem_online() && (gfp & __GFP_ACCOUNT))
5105 goto failed;
5106
5107 /* Use the single page allocator for one page. */
5108 if (nr_pages - nr_populated == 1)
5109 goto failed;
5110
5111#ifdef CONFIG_PAGE_OWNER
5112 /*
5113 * PAGE_OWNER may recurse into the allocator to allocate space to
5114 * save the stack with pagesets.lock held. Releasing/reacquiring
5115 * removes much of the performance benefit of bulk allocation so
5116 * force the caller to allocate one page at a time as it'll have
5117 * similar performance to added complexity to the bulk allocator.
5118 */
5119 if (static_branch_unlikely(&page_owner_inited))
5120 goto failed;
5121#endif
5122
5123 /* May set ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT, fragmentation will return 1 page. */
5124 gfp &= gfp_allowed_mask;
5125 alloc_gfp = gfp;
5126 if (!prepare_alloc_pages(gfp, 0, preferred_nid, nodemask, &ac, &alloc_gfp, &alloc_flags))
5127 goto out;
5128 gfp = alloc_gfp;
5129
5130 /* Find an allowed local zone that meets the low watermark. */
5131 z = ac.preferred_zoneref;
5132 for_next_zone_zonelist_nodemask(zone, z, ac.highest_zoneidx, ac.nodemask) {
5133 unsigned long mark;
5134
5135 if (cpusets_enabled() && (alloc_flags & ALLOC_CPUSET) &&
5136 !__cpuset_zone_allowed(zone, gfp)) {
5137 continue;
5138 }
5139
5140 if (nr_online_nodes > 1 && zone != zonelist_zone(ac.preferred_zoneref) &&
5141 zone_to_nid(zone) != zonelist_node_idx(ac.preferred_zoneref)) {
5142 goto failed;
5143 }
5144
5145 cond_accept_memory(zone, 0, alloc_flags);
5146retry_this_zone:
5147 mark = wmark_pages(zone, alloc_flags & ALLOC_WMARK_MASK) + nr_pages;
5148 if (zone_watermark_fast(zone, 0, mark,
5149 zonelist_zone_idx(ac.preferred_zoneref),
5150 alloc_flags, gfp)) {
5151 break;
5152 }
5153
5154 if (cond_accept_memory(zone, 0, alloc_flags))
5155 goto retry_this_zone;
5156
5157 /* Try again if zone has deferred pages */
5158 if (deferred_pages_enabled()) {
5159 if (_deferred_grow_zone(zone, 0))
5160 goto retry_this_zone;
5161 }
5162 }
5163
5164 /*
5165 * If there are no allowed local zones that meets the watermarks then
5166 * try to allocate a single page and reclaim if necessary.
5167 */
5168 if (unlikely(!zone))
5169 goto failed;
5170
5171 /* spin_trylock may fail due to a parallel drain or IRQ reentrancy. */
5172 pcp = pcp_spin_trylock(zone->per_cpu_pageset, UP_flags);
5173 if (!pcp)
5174 goto failed;
5175
5176 /* Attempt the batch allocation */
5177 pcp_list = &pcp->lists[order_to_pindex(ac.migratetype, 0)];
5178 while (nr_populated < nr_pages) {
5179
5180 /* Skip existing pages */
5181 if (page_array[nr_populated]) {
5182 nr_populated++;
5183 continue;
5184 }
5185
5186 page = __rmqueue_pcplist(zone, 0, ac.migratetype, alloc_flags,
5187 pcp, pcp_list);
5188 if (unlikely(!page)) {
5189 /* Try and allocate at least one page */
5190 if (!nr_account) {
5191 pcp_spin_unlock(pcp, UP_flags);
5192 goto failed;
5193 }
5194 break;
5195 }
5196 nr_account++;
5197
5198 prep_new_page(page, 0, gfp, 0);
5199 set_page_refcounted(page);
5200 page_array[nr_populated++] = page;
5201 }
5202
5203 pcp_spin_unlock(pcp, UP_flags);
5204
5205 __count_zid_vm_events(PGALLOC, zone_idx(zone), nr_account);
5206 zone_statistics(zonelist_zone(ac.preferred_zoneref), zone, nr_account);
5207
5208out:
5209 return nr_populated;
5210
5211failed:
5212 page = __alloc_pages_noprof(gfp, 0, preferred_nid, nodemask);
5213 if (page)
5214 page_array[nr_populated++] = page;
5215 goto out;
5216}
5217EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(alloc_pages_bulk_noprof);
5218
5219/*
5220 * This is the 'heart' of the zoned buddy allocator.
5221 */
5222struct page *__alloc_frozen_pages_noprof(gfp_t gfp, unsigned int order,
5223 int preferred_nid, nodemask_t *nodemask)
5224{
5225 struct page *page;
5226 unsigned int alloc_flags = ALLOC_WMARK_LOW;
5227 gfp_t alloc_gfp; /* The gfp_t that was actually used for allocation */
5228 struct alloc_context ac = { };
5229
5230 /*
5231 * There are several places where we assume that the order value is sane
5232 * so bail out early if the request is out of bound.
5233 */
5234 if (WARN_ON_ONCE_GFP(order > MAX_PAGE_ORDER, gfp))
5235 return NULL;
5236
5237 gfp &= gfp_allowed_mask;
5238 /*
5239 * Apply scoped allocation constraints. This is mainly about GFP_NOFS
5240 * resp. GFP_NOIO which has to be inherited for all allocation requests
5241 * from a particular context which has been marked by
5242 * memalloc_no{fs,io}_{save,restore}. And PF_MEMALLOC_PIN which ensures
5243 * movable zones are not used during allocation.
5244 */
5245 gfp = current_gfp_context(gfp);
5246 alloc_gfp = gfp;
5247 if (!prepare_alloc_pages(gfp, order, preferred_nid, nodemask, &ac,
5248 &alloc_gfp, &alloc_flags))
5249 return NULL;
5250
5251 /*
5252 * Forbid the first pass from falling back to types that fragment
5253 * memory until all local zones are considered.
5254 */
5255 alloc_flags |= alloc_flags_nofragment(zonelist_zone(ac.preferred_zoneref), gfp);
5256
5257 /* First allocation attempt */
5258 page = get_page_from_freelist(alloc_gfp, order, alloc_flags, &ac);
5259 if (likely(page))
5260 goto out;
5261
5262 alloc_gfp = gfp;
5263 ac.spread_dirty_pages = false;
5264
5265 /*
5266 * Restore the original nodemask if it was potentially replaced with
5267 * &cpuset_current_mems_allowed to optimize the fast-path attempt.
5268 */
5269 ac.nodemask = nodemask;
5270
5271 page = __alloc_pages_slowpath(alloc_gfp, order, &ac);
5272
5273out:
5274 if (memcg_kmem_online() && (gfp & __GFP_ACCOUNT) && page &&
5275 unlikely(__memcg_kmem_charge_page(page, gfp, order) != 0)) {
5276 free_frozen_pages(page, order);
5277 page = NULL;
5278 }
5279
5280 trace_mm_page_alloc(page, order, alloc_gfp, ac.migratetype);
5281 kmsan_alloc_page(page, order, alloc_gfp);
5282
5283 return page;
5284}
5285EXPORT_SYMBOL(__alloc_frozen_pages_noprof);
5286
5287struct page *__alloc_pages_noprof(gfp_t gfp, unsigned int order,
5288 int preferred_nid, nodemask_t *nodemask)
5289{
5290 struct page *page;
5291
5292 page = __alloc_frozen_pages_noprof(gfp, order, preferred_nid, nodemask);
5293 if (page)
5294 set_page_refcounted(page);
5295 return page;
5296}
5297EXPORT_SYMBOL(__alloc_pages_noprof);

5308/*
5309 * Common helper functions. Never use with __GFP_HIGHMEM because the returned
5310 * address cannot represent highmem pages. Use alloc_pages and then kmap if
5311 * you need to access high mem.
5312 */
5313unsigned long get_free_pages_noprof(gfp_t gfp_mask, unsigned int order)
5314{
5315 struct page *page;
5316
5317 page = alloc_pages_noprof(gfp_mask & ~__GFP_HIGHMEM, order);
5318 if (!page)
5319 return 0;
5320 return (unsigned long) page_address(page);

5330static void ___free_pages(struct page *page, unsigned int order,
5331 fpi_t fpi_flags)
5332{
5333 /* get PageHead before we drop reference */
5334 int head = PageHead(page);
5335 /* get alloc tag in case the page is released by others */
5336 struct alloc_tag *tag = pgalloc_tag_get(page);
5337
5338 if (put_page_testzero(page))
5339 __free_frozen_pages(page, order, fpi_flags);
5340 else if (!head) {
5341 pgalloc_tag_sub_pages(tag, (1 << order) - 1);
5342 while (order-- > 0) {
5343 /*
5344 * The "tail" pages of this non-compound high-order
5345 * page will have no code tags, so to avoid warnings
5346 * mark them as empty.
5347 */
5348 clear_page_tag_ref(page + (1 << order));
5349 __free_frozen_pages(page + (1 << order), order,
5350 fpi_flags);
5351 }
5352 }
5353}
5354
5375void __free_pages(struct page *page, unsigned int order)
5376{
5377 ___free_pages(page, order, FPI_NONE);
5378}
5379EXPORT_SYMBOL(__free_pages);

5381/*
5382 * Can be called while holding raw_spin_lock or from IRQ and NMI for any
5383 * page type (not only those that came from alloc_pages_nolock)
5384 */
5385void free_pages_nolock(struct page *page, unsigned int order)
5386{
5387 ___free_pages(page, order, FPI_TRYLOCK);

5399void free_pages(unsigned long addr, unsigned int order)
5400{
5401 if (addr != 0) {
5402 VM_BUG_ON(!virt_addr_valid((void *)addr));
5403 __free_pages(virt_to_page((void *)addr), order);
5404 }

5408
5409static void *make_alloc_exact(unsigned long addr, unsigned int order,
5410 size_t size)
5411{
5412 if (addr) {
5413 unsigned long nr = DIV_ROUND_UP(size, PAGE_SIZE);
5414 struct page *page = virt_to_page((void *)addr);
5415 struct page *last = page + nr;
5416
5417 __split_page(page, order);
5418 while (page < --last)
5419 set_page_refcounted(last);
5420
5421 last = page + (1UL << order);
5422 for (page += nr; page < last; page++)
5423 __free_pages_ok(page, 0, FPI_TO_TAIL);
5424 }
5425 return (void *)addr;
5426}
5427
5443void *alloc_pages_exact_noprof(size_t size, gfp_t gfp_mask)
5444{
5445 unsigned int order = get_order(size);
5446 unsigned long addr;
5447
5448 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(gfp_mask & (__GFP_COMP | __GFP_HIGHMEM)))
5449 gfp_mask &= ~(__GFP_COMP | __GFP_HIGHMEM);
5450
5451 addr = get_free_pages_noprof(gfp_mask, order);
5452 return make_alloc_exact(addr, order, size);
5453}
5454EXPORT_SYMBOL(alloc_pages_exact_noprof);

5468void * __meminit alloc_pages_exact_nid_noprof(int nid, size_t size, gfp_t gfp_mask)
5469{
5470 unsigned int order = get_order(size);
5471 struct page *p;
5472
5473 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(gfp_mask & (__GFP_COMP | __GFP_HIGHMEM)))
5474 gfp_mask &= ~(__GFP_COMP | __GFP_HIGHMEM);
5475
5476 p = alloc_pages_node_noprof(nid, gfp_mask, order);
5477 if (!p)
5478 return NULL;
5479 return make_alloc_exact((unsigned long)page_address(p), order, size);
5480}
5481
5489void free_pages_exact(void *virt, size_t size)
5490{
5491 unsigned long addr = (unsigned long)virt;
5492 unsigned long end = addr + PAGE_ALIGN(size);
5493
5494 while (addr < end) {
5495 free_page(addr);
5496 addr += PAGE_SIZE;
5497 }
5498}
5499EXPORT_SYMBOL(free_pages_exact);

5513static unsigned long nr_free_zone_pages(int offset)
5514{
5515 struct zoneref *z;
5516 struct zone *zone;
5517
5518 /* Just pick one node, since fallback list is circular */
5519 unsigned long sum = 0;
5520
5521 struct zonelist *zonelist = node_zonelist(numa_node_id(), GFP_KERNEL);
5522
5523 for_each_zone_zonelist(zone, z, zonelist, offset) {
5524 unsigned long size = zone_managed_pages(zone);
5525 unsigned long high = high_wmark_pages(zone);
5526 if (size > high)
5527 sum += size - high;
5528 }
5529
5530 return sum;
5531}
5532
5542unsigned long nr_free_buffer_pages(void)
5543{
5544 return nr_free_zone_pages(gfp_zone(GFP_USER));

5554/*
5555 * Builds allocation fallback zone lists.
5556 *
5557 * Add all populated zones of a node to the zonelist.
5558 */
5559static int build_zonerefs_node(pg_data_t *pgdat, struct zoneref *zonerefs)
5560{
5561 struct zone *zone;
5562 enum zone_type zone_type = MAX_NR_ZONES;
5563 int nr_zones = 0;
5564
5565 do {
5566 zone_type--;
5567 zone = pgdat->node_zones + zone_type;
5568 if (populated_zone(zone)) {
5569 zoneref_set_zone(zone, &zonerefs[nr_zones++]);
5570 check_highest_zone(zone_type);
5571 }
5572 } while (zone_type);
5573
5574 return nr_zones;
5575}

5606
5607static int node_load[MAX_NUMNODES];
5608
5624int find_next_best_node(int node, nodemask_t *used_node_mask)
5625{
5626 int n, val;
5627 int min_val = INT_MAX;
5628 int best_node = NUMA_NO_NODE;
5629
5630 /*
5631 * Use the local node if we haven't already, but for memoryless local
5632 * node, we should skip it and fall back to other nodes.
5633 */
5634 if (!node_isset(node, *used_node_mask) && node_state(node, N_MEMORY)) {
5635 node_set(node, *used_node_mask);
5636 return node;
5637 }
5638
5639 for_each_node_state(n, N_MEMORY) {
5640
5641 /* Don't want a node to appear more than once */
5642 if (node_isset(n, *used_node_mask))
5643 continue;
5644
5645 /* Use the distance array to find the distance */
5646 val = node_distance(node, n);
5647
5648 /* Penalize nodes under us ("prefer the next node") */
5649 val += (n < node);
5650
5651 /* Give preference to headless and unused nodes */
5652 if (!cpumask_empty(cpumask_of_node(n)))
5653 val += PENALTY_FOR_NODE_WITH_CPUS;
5654
5655 /* Slight preference for less loaded node */
5656 val *= MAX_NUMNODES;
5657 val += node_load[n];
5658
5659 if (val < min_val) {
5660 min_val = val;
5661 best_node = n;
5662 }
5663 }
5664
5665 if (best_node >= 0)
5666 node_set(best_node, *used_node_mask);
5667
5668 return best_node;
5669}

5672/*
5673 * Build zonelists ordered by node and zones within node.
5674 * This results in maximum locality--normal zone overflows into local
5675 * DMA zone, if any--but risks exhausting DMA zone.
5676 */
5677static void build_zonelists_in_node_order(pg_data_t *pgdat, int *node_order,
5678 unsigned nr_nodes)
5679{
5680 struct zoneref *zonerefs;
5681 int i;
5682
5683 zonerefs = pgdat->node_zonelists[ZONELIST_FALLBACK]._zonerefs;
5684
5685 for (i = 0; i < nr_nodes; i++) {
5686 int nr_zones;
5687
5688 pg_data_t *node = NODE_DATA(node_order[i]);
5689
5690 nr_zones = build_zonerefs_node(node, zonerefs);
5691 zonerefs += nr_zones;
5692 }
5693 zonerefs->zone = NULL;
5694 zonerefs->zone_idx = 0;
5695}
5696
5697/*
5698 * Build __GFP_THISNODE zonelists
5699 */
5700static void build_thisnode_zonelists(pg_data_t *pgdat)
5701{
5702 struct zoneref *zonerefs;
5703 int nr_zones;
5704
5705 zonerefs = pgdat->node_zonelists[ZONELIST_NOFALLBACK]._zonerefs;
5706 nr_zones = build_zonerefs_node(pgdat, zonerefs);
5707 zonerefs += nr_zones;
5708 zonerefs->zone = NULL;
5709 zonerefs->zone_idx = 0;
5710}
5711
5712static void build_zonelists(pg_data_t *pgdat)
5713{
5714 static int node_order[MAX_NUMNODES];
5715 int node, nr_nodes = 0;
5716 nodemask_t used_mask = NODE_MASK_NONE;
5717 int local_node, prev_node;
5718
5719 /* NUMA-aware ordering of nodes */
5720 local_node = pgdat->node_id;
5721 prev_node = local_node;
5722
5723 memset(node_order, 0, sizeof(node_order));
5724 while ((node = find_next_best_node(local_node, &used_mask)) >= 0) {
5725 /*
5726 * We don't want to pressure a particular node.
5727 * So adding penalty to the first node in same
5728 * distance group to make it round-robin.
5729 */
5730 if (node_distance(local_node, node) !=
5731 node_distance(local_node, prev_node))
5732 node_load[node] += 1;
5733
5734 node_order[nr_nodes++] = node;
5735 prev_node = node;
5736 }
5737
5738 build_zonelists_in_node_order(pgdat, node_order, nr_nodes);
5739 build_thisnode_zonelists(pgdat);
5740 pr_info("Fallback order for Node %d: ", local_node);
5741 for (node = 0; node < nr_nodes; node++)
5742 pr_cont("%d ", node_order[node]);
5743 pr_cont("\n");
5744}

5783/*
5784 * Boot pageset table. One per cpu which is going to be used for all
5785 * zones and all nodes. The parameters will be set in such a way
5786 * that an item put on a list will immediately be handed over to
5787 * the buddy list. This is safe since pageset manipulation is done
5788 * with interrupts disabled.
5789 *
5790 * The boot_pagesets must be kept even after bootup is complete for
5791 * unused processors and/or zones. They do play a role for bootstrapping
5792 * hotplugged processors.
5793 *
5794 * zoneinfo_show() and maybe other functions do
5795 * not check if the processor is online before following the pageset pointer.
5796 * Other parts of the kernel may not check if the zone is available.
5797 */
5798static void per_cpu_pages_init(struct per_cpu_pages *pcp, struct per_cpu_zonestat *pzstats);
5799/* These effectively disable the pcplists in the boot pageset completely */
5800#define BOOT_PAGESET_HIGH 0
5801#define BOOT_PAGESET_BATCH 1
5802static DEFINE_PER_CPU(struct per_cpu_pages, boot_pageset);
5803static DEFINE_PER_CPU(struct per_cpu_zonestat, boot_zonestats);
5804
5805static void __build_all_zonelists(void *data)
5806{
5807 int nid;
5808 int __maybe_unused cpu;
5809 pg_data_t *self = data;
5810 unsigned long flags;
5811
5812 /*
5813 * The zonelist_update_seq must be acquired with irqsave because the
5814 * reader can be invoked from IRQ with GFP_ATOMIC.
5815 */
5816 write_seqlock_irqsave(&zonelist_update_seq, flags);
5817 /*
5818 * Also disable synchronous printk() to prevent any printk() from
5819 * trying to hold port->lock, for
5820 * tty_insert_flip_string_and_push_buffer() on other CPU might be
5821 * calling kmalloc(GFP_ATOMIC | __GFP_NOWARN) with port->lock held.
5822 */
5823 printk_deferred_enter();
5824
5825#ifdef CONFIG_NUMA
5826 memset(node_load, 0, sizeof(node_load));
5827#endif
5828
5829 /*
5830 * This node is hotadded and no memory is yet present. So just
5831 * building zonelists is fine - no need to touch other nodes.
5832 */
5833 if (self && !node_online(self->node_id)) {
5834 build_zonelists(self);
5835 } else {
5836 /*
5837 * All possible nodes have pgdat preallocated
5838 * in free_area_init
5839 */
5840 for_each_node(nid) {
5841 pg_data_t *pgdat = NODE_DATA(nid);
5842
5843 build_zonelists(pgdat);
5844 }
5845
5846#ifdef CONFIG_HAVE_MEMORYLESS_NODES
5847 /*
5848 * We now know the "local memory node" for each node--
5849 * i.e., the node of the first zone in the generic zonelist.
5850 * Set up numa_mem percpu variable for on-line cpus. During
5851 * boot, only the boot cpu should be on-line; we'll init the
5852 * secondary cpus' numa_mem as they come on-line. During
5853 * node/memory hotplug, we'll fixup all on-line cpus.
5854 */
5855 for_each_online_cpu(cpu)
5856 set_cpu_numa_mem(cpu, local_memory_node(cpu_to_node(cpu)));
5857#endif
5858 }
5859
5860 printk_deferred_exit();
5861 write_sequnlock_irqrestore(&zonelist_update_seq, flags);
5862}
5863
5864static noinline void __init
5865build_all_zonelists_init(void)
5866{
5867 int cpu;
5868
5869 __build_all_zonelists(NULL);
5870
5871 /*
5872 * Initialize the boot_pagesets that are going to be used
5873 * for bootstrapping processors. The real pagesets for
5874 * each zone will be allocated later when the per cpu
5875 * allocator is available.
5876 *
5877 * boot_pagesets are used also for bootstrapping offline
5878 * cpus if the system is already booted because the pagesets
5879 * are needed to initialize allocators on a specific cpu too.
5880 * F.e. the percpu allocator needs the page allocator which
5881 * needs the percpu allocator in order to allocate its pagesets
5882 * (a chicken-egg dilemma).
5883 */
5884 for_each_possible_cpu(cpu)
5885 per_cpu_pages_init(&per_cpu(boot_pageset, cpu), &per_cpu(boot_zonestats, cpu));
5886
5887 mminit_verify_zonelist();
5888 cpuset_init_current_mems_allowed();
5889}

5891/*
5892 * unless system_state == SYSTEM_BOOTING.
5893 *
5894 * __ref due to call of __init annotated helper build_all_zonelists_init
5895 * [protected by SYSTEM_BOOTING].
5896 */
5897void __ref build_all_zonelists(pg_data_t *pgdat)
5898{
5899 unsigned long vm_total_pages;
5900
5901 if (system_state == SYSTEM_BOOTING) {
5902 build_all_zonelists_init();
5903 } else {
5904 __build_all_zonelists(pgdat);
5905 /* cpuset refresh routine should be here */
5906 }
5907 /* Get the number of free pages beyond high watermark in all zones. */
5908 vm_total_pages = nr_free_zone_pages(gfp_zone(GFP_HIGHUSER_MOVABLE));
5909 /*
5910 * Disable grouping by mobility if the number of pages in the
5911 * system is too low to allow the mechanism to work. It would be
5912 * more accurate, but expensive to check per-zone. This check is
5913 * made on memory-hotadd so a system can start with mobility
5914 * disabled and enable it later
5915 */
5916 if (vm_total_pages < (pageblock_nr_pages * MIGRATE_TYPES))
5917 page_group_by_mobility_disabled = 1;
5918 else
5919 page_group_by_mobility_disabled = 0;
5920
5921 pr_info("Built %u zonelists, mobility grouping %s. Total pages: %ld\n",
5922 nr_online_nodes,
5923 str_off_on(page_group_by_mobility_disabled),
5924 vm_total_pages);
5925#ifdef CONFIG_NUMA
5926 pr_info("Policy zone: %s\n", zone_names[policy_zone]);
5927#endif
5928}
5929
5930static int zone_batchsize(struct zone *zone)
5931{
5932#ifdef CONFIG_MMU
5933 int batch;
5934
5935 /*
5936 * The number of pages to batch allocate is either ~0.025%
5937 * of the zone or 256KB, whichever is smaller. The batch
5938 * size is striking a balance between allocation latency
5939 * and zone lock contention.
5940 */
5941 batch = min(zone_managed_pages(zone) >> 12, SZ_256K / PAGE_SIZE);
5942 if (batch <= 1)
5943 return 1;
5944
5945 /*
5946 * Clamp the batch to a 2^n - 1 value. Having a power
5947 * of 2 value was found to be more likely to have
5948 * suboptimal cache aliasing properties in some cases.
5949 *
5950 * For example if 2 tasks are alternately allocating
5951 * batches of pages, one task can end up with a lot
5952 * of pages of one half of the possible page colors
5953 * and the other with pages of the other colors.
5954 */
5955 batch = rounddown_pow_of_two(batch + batch/2) - 1;
5956
5957 return batch;
5958
5959#else
5960 /* The deferral and batching of frees should be suppressed under NOMMU
5961 * conditions.
5962 *
5963 * The problem is that NOMMU needs to be able to allocate large chunks
5964 * of contiguous memory as there's no hardware page translation to
5965 * assemble apparent contiguous memory from discontiguous pages.
5966 *
5967 * Queueing large contiguous runs of pages for batching, however,
5968 * causes the pages to actually be freed in smaller chunks. As there
5969 * can be a significant delay between the individual batches being
5970 * recycled, this leads to the once large chunks of space being
5971 * fragmented and becoming unavailable for high-order allocations.
5972 */
5973 return 1;
5974#endif
5975}
5976
5977static int percpu_pagelist_high_fraction;
5978static int zone_highsize(struct zone *zone, int batch, int cpu_online,
5979 int high_fraction)
5980{
5981#ifdef CONFIG_MMU
5982 int high;
5983 int nr_split_cpus;
5984 unsigned long total_pages;
5985
5986 if (!high_fraction) {
5987 /*
5988 * By default, the high value of the pcp is based on the zone
5989 * low watermark so that if they are full then background
5990 * reclaim will not be started prematurely.
5991 */
5992 total_pages = low_wmark_pages(zone);
5993 } else {
5994 /*
5995 * If percpu_pagelist_high_fraction is configured, the high
5996 * value is based on a fraction of the managed pages in the
5997 * zone.
5998 */
5999 total_pages = zone_managed_pages(zone) / high_fraction;
6000 }
6001
6002 /*
6003 * Split the high value across all online CPUs local to the zone. Note
6004 * that early in boot that CPUs may not be online yet and that during
6005 * CPU hotplug that the cpumask is not yet updated when a CPU is being
6006 * onlined. For memory nodes that have no CPUs, split the high value
6007 * across all online CPUs to mitigate the risk that reclaim is triggered
6008 * prematurely due to pages stored on pcp lists.
6009 */
6010 nr_split_cpus = cpumask_weight(cpumask_of_node(zone_to_nid(zone))) + cpu_online;
6011 if (!nr_split_cpus)
6012 nr_split_cpus = num_online_cpus();
6013 high = total_pages / nr_split_cpus;
6014
6015 /*
6016 * Ensure high is at least batch*4. The multiple is based on the
6017 * historical relationship between high and batch.
6018 */
6019 high = max(high, batch << 2);
6020
6021 return high;
6022#else
6023 return 0;
6024#endif
6025}
6026
6027/*
6028 * pcp->high and pcp->batch values are related and generally batch is lower
6029 * than high. They are also related to pcp->count such that count is lower
6030 * than high, and as soon as it reaches high, the pcplist is flushed.
6031 *
6032 * However, guaranteeing these relations at all times would require e.g. write
6033 * barriers here but also careful usage of read barriers at the read side, and
6034 * thus be prone to error and bad for performance. Thus the update only prevents
6035 * store tearing. Any new users of pcp->batch, pcp->high_min and pcp->high_max
6036 * should ensure they can cope with those fields changing asynchronously, and
6037 * fully trust only the pcp->count field on the local CPU with interrupts
6038 * disabled.
6039 *
6040 * mutex_is_locked(&pcp_batch_high_lock) required when calling this function
6041 * outside of boot time (or some other assurance that no concurrent updaters
6042 * exist).
6043 */
6044static void pageset_update(struct per_cpu_pages *pcp, unsigned long high_min,
6045 unsigned long high_max, unsigned long batch)
6046{
6047 WRITE_ONCE(pcp->batch, batch);
6048 WRITE_ONCE(pcp->high_min, high_min);
6049 WRITE_ONCE(pcp->high_max, high_max);
6050}
6051
6052static void per_cpu_pages_init(struct per_cpu_pages *pcp, struct per_cpu_zonestat *pzstats)
6053{
6054 int pindex;
6055
6056 memset(pcp, 0, sizeof(*pcp));
6057 memset(pzstats, 0, sizeof(*pzstats));
6058
6059 spin_lock_init(&pcp->lock);
6060 for (pindex = 0; pindex < NR_PCP_LISTS; pindex++)
6061 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&pcp->lists[pindex]);
6062
6063 /*
6064 * Set batch and high values safe for a boot pageset. A true percpu
6065 * pageset's initialization will update them subsequently. Here we don't
6066 * need to be as careful as pageset_update() as nobody can access the
6067 * pageset yet.
6068 */
6069 pcp->high_min = BOOT_PAGESET_HIGH;
6070 pcp->high_max = BOOT_PAGESET_HIGH;
6071 pcp->batch = BOOT_PAGESET_BATCH;
6072}
6073
6074static void __zone_set_pageset_high_and_batch(struct zone *zone, unsigned long high_min,
6075 unsigned long high_max, unsigned long batch)
6076{
6077 struct per_cpu_pages *pcp;
6078 int cpu;
6079
6080 for_each_possible_cpu(cpu) {
6081 pcp = per_cpu_ptr(zone->per_cpu_pageset, cpu);
6082 pageset_update(pcp, high_min, high_max, batch);
6083 }
6084}
6085
6086/*
6087 * Calculate and set new high and batch values for all per-cpu pagesets of a
6088 * zone based on the zone's size.
6089 */
6090static void zone_set_pageset_high_and_batch(struct zone *zone, int cpu_online)
6091{
6092 int new_high_min, new_high_max, new_batch;
6093
6094 new_batch = zone_batchsize(zone);
6095 if (percpu_pagelist_high_fraction) {
6096 new_high_min = zone_highsize(zone, new_batch, cpu_online,
6097 percpu_pagelist_high_fraction);
6098 /*
6099 * PCP high is tuned manually, disable auto-tuning via
6100 * setting high_min and high_max to the manual value.
6101 */
6102 new_high_max = new_high_min;
6103 } else {
6104 new_high_min = zone_highsize(zone, new_batch, cpu_online, 0);
6105 new_high_max = zone_highsize(zone, new_batch, cpu_online,
6106 MIN_PERCPU_PAGELIST_HIGH_FRACTION);
6107 }
6108
6109 if (zone->pageset_high_min == new_high_min &&
6110 zone->pageset_high_max == new_high_max &&
6111 zone->pageset_batch == new_batch)
6112 return;
6113
6114 zone->pageset_high_min = new_high_min;
6115 zone->pageset_high_max = new_high_max;
6116 zone->pageset_batch = new_batch;
6117
6118 __zone_set_pageset_high_and_batch(zone, new_high_min, new_high_max,
6119 new_batch);
6120}

6122void __meminit setup_zone_pageset(struct zone *zone)
6123{
6124 int cpu;
6125
6126 /* Size may be 0 on !SMP && !NUMA */
6127 if (sizeof(struct per_cpu_zonestat) > 0)
6128 zone->per_cpu_zonestats = alloc_percpu(struct per_cpu_zonestat);
6129
6130 zone->per_cpu_pageset = alloc_percpu(struct per_cpu_pages);
6131 for_each_possible_cpu(cpu) {
6132 struct per_cpu_pages *pcp;
6133 struct per_cpu_zonestat *pzstats;
6134
6135 pcp = per_cpu_ptr(zone->per_cpu_pageset, cpu);
6136 pzstats = per_cpu_ptr(zone->per_cpu_zonestats, cpu);
6137 per_cpu_pages_init(pcp, pzstats);
6138 }
6139
6140 zone_set_pageset_high_and_batch(zone, 0);
6141}

6143/*
6144 * The zone indicated has a new number of managed_pages; batch sizes and percpu
6145 * page high values need to be recalculated.
6146 */
6147static void zone_pcp_update(struct zone *zone, int cpu_online)
6148{
6149 mutex_lock(&pcp_batch_high_lock);
6150 zone_set_pageset_high_and_batch(zone, cpu_online);
6151 mutex_unlock(&pcp_batch_high_lock);

6153
6154static void zone_pcp_update_cacheinfo(struct zone *zone, unsigned int cpu)
6155{
6156 struct per_cpu_pages *pcp;
6157 struct cpu_cacheinfo *cci;
6158 unsigned long UP_flags;
6159
6160 pcp = per_cpu_ptr(zone->per_cpu_pageset, cpu);
6161 cci = get_cpu_cacheinfo(cpu);
6162 /*
6163 * If data cache slice of CPU is large enough, "pcp->batch"
6164 * pages can be preserved in PCP before draining PCP for
6165 * consecutive high-order pages freeing without allocation.
6166 * This can reduce zone lock contention without hurting
6167 * cache-hot pages sharing.
6168 */
6169 pcp_spin_lock_maybe_irqsave(pcp, UP_flags);
6170 if ((cci->per_cpu_data_slice_size >> PAGE_SHIFT) > 3 * pcp->batch)
6171 pcp->flags |= PCPF_FREE_HIGH_BATCH;
6172 else
6173 pcp->flags &= ~PCPF_FREE_HIGH_BATCH;
6174 pcp_spin_unlock_maybe_irqrestore(pcp, UP_flags);
6175}
6176
6177void setup_pcp_cacheinfo(unsigned int cpu)
6178{
6179 struct zone *zone;
6180
6181 for_each_populated_zone(zone)
6182 zone_pcp_update_cacheinfo(zone, cpu);
6183}
6184
6185/*
6186 * Allocate per cpu pagesets and initialize them.
6187 * Before this call only boot pagesets were available.
6188 */
6189void __init setup_per_cpu_pageset(void)
6190{
6191 struct pglist_data *pgdat;
6192 struct zone *zone;
6193 int __maybe_unused cpu;
6194
6195 for_each_populated_zone(zone)
6196 setup_zone_pageset(zone);
6197
6198#ifdef CONFIG_NUMA
6199 /*
6200 * Unpopulated zones continue using the boot pagesets.
6201 * The numa stats for these pagesets need to be reset.
6202 * Otherwise, they will end up skewing the stats of
6203 * the nodes these zones are associated with.
6204 */
6205 for_each_possible_cpu(cpu) {
6206 struct per_cpu_zonestat *pzstats = &per_cpu(boot_zonestats, cpu);
6207 memset(pzstats->vm_numa_event, 0,
6208 sizeof(pzstats->vm_numa_event));
6209 }
6210#endif
6211
6212 for_each_online_pgdat(pgdat)
6213 pgdat->per_cpu_nodestats =
6214 alloc_percpu(struct per_cpu_nodestat);
6215}

6217__meminit void zone_pcp_init(struct zone *zone)
6218{
6219 /*
6220 * per cpu subsystem is not up at this point. The following code
6221 * relies on the ability of the linker to provide the
6222 * offset of a (static) per cpu variable into the per cpu area.
6223 */
6224 zone->per_cpu_pageset = &boot_pageset;
6225 zone->per_cpu_zonestats = &boot_zonestats;
6226 zone->pageset_high_min = BOOT_PAGESET_HIGH;
6227 zone->pageset_high_max = BOOT_PAGESET_HIGH;
6228 zone->pageset_batch = BOOT_PAGESET_BATCH;
6229
6230 if (populated_zone(zone))
6231 pr_debug(" %s zone: %lu pages, LIFO batch:%u\n", zone->name,
6232 zone->present_pages, zone_batchsize(zone));
6233}

6237void adjust_managed_page_count(struct page *page, long count)
6238{
6239 atomic_long_add(count, &page_zone(page)->managed_pages);
6240 totalram_pages_add(count);

6244
6245unsigned long free_reserved_area(void *start, void *end, int poison, const char *s)
6246{
6247 void *pos;
6248 unsigned long pages = 0;
6249
6250 start = (void *)PAGE_ALIGN((unsigned long)start);
6251 end = (void *)((unsigned long)end & PAGE_MASK);
6252 for (pos = start; pos < end; pos += PAGE_SIZE, pages++) {
6253 struct page *page = virt_to_page(pos);
6254 void *direct_map_addr;
6255
6256 /*
6257 * 'direct_map_addr' might be different from 'pos'
6258 * because some architectures' virt_to_page()
6259 * work with aliases. Getting the direct map
6260 * address ensures that we get a _writeable_
6261 * alias for the memset().
6262 */
6263 direct_map_addr = page_address(page);
6264 /*
6265 * Perform a kasan-unchecked memset() since this memory
6266 * has not been initialized.
6267 */
6268 direct_map_addr = kasan_reset_tag(direct_map_addr);
6269 if ((unsigned int)poison <= 0xFF)
6270 memset(direct_map_addr, poison, PAGE_SIZE);
6271
6272 free_reserved_page(page);
6273 }
6274
6275 if (pages && s)
6276 pr_info("Freeing %s memory: %ldK\n", s, K(pages));
6277
6278 return pages;
6279}
6280
6281void free_reserved_page(struct page *page)
6282{
6283 clear_page_tag_ref(page);
6284 ClearPageReserved(page);
6285 init_page_count(page);
6286 __free_page(page);
6287 adjust_managed_page_count(page, 1);
6288}
6289EXPORT_SYMBOL(free_reserved_page);

6291static int page_alloc_cpu_dead(unsigned int cpu)
6292{
6293 struct zone *zone;
6294
6295 lru_add_drain_cpu(cpu);
6296 mlock_drain_remote(cpu);
6297 drain_pages(cpu);
6298
6299 /*
6300 * Spill the event counters of the dead processor
6301 * into the current processors event counters.
6302 * This artificially elevates the count of the current
6303 * processor.
6304 */
6305 vm_events_fold_cpu(cpu);
6306
6307 /*
6308 * Zero the differential counters of the dead processor
6309 * so that the vm statistics are consistent.
6310 *
6311 * This is only okay since the processor is dead and cannot
6312 * race with what we are doing.
6313 */
6314 cpu_vm_stats_fold(cpu);
6315
6316 for_each_populated_zone(zone)
6317 zone_pcp_update(zone, 0);
6318
6319 return 0;
6320}

6323{

6325

6328 return 0;
6329}

6341
6342/*
6343 * calculate_totalreserve_pages - called when sysctl_lowmem_reserve_ratio
6344 * or min_free_kbytes changes.
6345 */
6346static void calculate_totalreserve_pages(void)
6347{
6348 struct pglist_data *pgdat;
6349 unsigned long reserve_pages = 0;
6350 enum zone_type i, j;
6351
6352 for_each_online_pgdat(pgdat) {
6353
6354 pgdat->totalreserve_pages = 0;
6355
6356 for (i = 0; i < MAX_NR_ZONES; i++) {
6357 struct zone *zone = pgdat->node_zones + i;
6358 long max = 0;
6359 unsigned long managed_pages = zone_managed_pages(zone);
6360
6361 /*
6362 * lowmem_reserve[j] is monotonically non-decreasing
6363 * in j for a given zone (see
6364 * setup_per_zone_lowmem_reserve()). The maximum
6365 * valid reserve lives at the highest index with a
6366 * non-zero value, so scan backwards and stop at the
6367 * first hit.
6368 */
6369 for (j = MAX_NR_ZONES - 1; j > i; j--) {
6370 if (!zone->lowmem_reserve[j])
6371 continue;
6372
6373 max = zone->lowmem_reserve[j];
6374 break;
6375 }
6376 /* we treat the high watermark as reserved pages. */
6377 max += high_wmark_pages(zone);
6378
6379 max = min_t(unsigned long, max, managed_pages);
6380
6381 pgdat->totalreserve_pages += max;
6382
6383 reserve_pages += max;
6384 }
6385 }
6386 totalreserve_pages = reserve_pages;
6387 trace_mm_calculate_totalreserve_pages(totalreserve_pages);
6388}
6389
6390/*
6391 * setup_per_zone_lowmem_reserve - called whenever
6392 * sysctl_lowmem_reserve_ratio changes. Ensures that each zone
6393 * has a correct pages reserved value, so an adequate number of
6394 * pages are left in the zone after a successful __alloc_pages().
6395 */
6396static void setup_per_zone_lowmem_reserve(void)
6397{
6398 struct pglist_data *pgdat;
6399 enum zone_type i, j;
6400 /*
6401 * For a given zone node_zones[i], lowmem_reserve[j] (j > i)
6402 * represents how many pages in zone i must effectively be kept
6403 * in reserve when deciding whether an allocation class that is
6404 * allowed to allocate from zones up to j may fall back into
6405 * zone i.
6406 *
6407 * As j increases, the allocation class can use a strictly larger
6408 * set of fallback zones and therefore must not be allowed to
6409 * deplete low zones more aggressively than a less flexible one.
6410 * As a result, lowmem_reserve[j] is required to be monotonically
6411 * non-decreasing in j for each zone i. Callers such as
6412 * calculate_totalreserve_pages() rely on this monotonicity when
6413 * selecting the maximum reserve entry.
6414 */
6415 for_each_online_pgdat(pgdat) {
6416 for (i = 0; i < MAX_NR_ZONES - 1; i++) {
6417 struct zone *zone = &pgdat->node_zones[i];
6418 int ratio = sysctl_lowmem_reserve_ratio[i];
6419 bool clear = !ratio || !zone_managed_pages(zone);
6420 unsigned long managed_pages = 0;
6421
6422 for (j = i + 1; j < MAX_NR_ZONES; j++) {
6423 struct zone *upper_zone = &pgdat->node_zones[j];
6424
6425 managed_pages += zone_managed_pages(upper_zone);
6426
6427 if (clear)
6428 zone->lowmem_reserve[j] = 0;
6429 else
6430 zone->lowmem_reserve[j] = managed_pages / ratio;
6431 trace_mm_setup_per_zone_lowmem_reserve(zone, upper_zone,
6432 zone->lowmem_reserve[j]);
6433 }
6434 }
6435 }
6436
6437 /* update totalreserve_pages */
6438 calculate_totalreserve_pages();
6439}
6440
6441static void __setup_per_zone_wmarks(void)
6442{
6443 unsigned long pages_min = min_free_kbytes >> (PAGE_SHIFT - 10);
6444 unsigned long lowmem_pages = 0;
6445 struct zone *zone;
6446 unsigned long flags;
6447
6448 /* Calculate total number of !ZONE_HIGHMEM and !ZONE_MOVABLE pages */
6449 for_each_zone(zone) {
6450 if (!is_highmem(zone) && zone_idx(zone) != ZONE_MOVABLE)
6451 lowmem_pages += zone_managed_pages(zone);
6452 }
6453
6454 for_each_zone(zone) {
6455 u64 tmp;
6456
6457 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
6458 tmp = (u64)pages_min * zone_managed_pages(zone);
6459 tmp = div64_ul(tmp, lowmem_pages);
6460 if (is_highmem(zone) || zone_idx(zone) == ZONE_MOVABLE) {
6461 /*
6462 * __GFP_HIGH and PF_MEMALLOC allocations usually don't
6463 * need highmem and movable zones pages, so cap pages_min
6464 * to a small value here.
6465 *
6466 * The WMARK_HIGH-WMARK_LOW and (WMARK_LOW-WMARK_MIN)
6467 * deltas control async page reclaim, and so should
6468 * not be capped for highmem and movable zones.
6469 */
6470 unsigned long min_pages;
6471
6472 min_pages = zone_managed_pages(zone) / 1024;
6473 min_pages = clamp(min_pages, SWAP_CLUSTER_MAX, 128UL);
6474 zone->_watermark[WMARK_MIN] = min_pages;
6475 } else {
6476 /*
6477 * If it's a lowmem zone, reserve a number of pages
6478 * proportionate to the zone's size.
6479 */
6480 zone->_watermark[WMARK_MIN] = tmp;
6481 }
6482
6483 /*
6484 * Set the kswapd watermarks distance according to the
6485 * scale factor in proportion to available memory, but
6486 * ensure a minimum size on small systems.
6487 */
6488 tmp = max_t(u64, tmp >> 2,
6489 mult_frac(zone_managed_pages(zone),
6490 watermark_scale_factor, 10000));
6491
6492 zone->watermark_boost = 0;
6493 zone->_watermark[WMARK_LOW] = min_wmark_pages(zone) + tmp;
6494 zone->_watermark[WMARK_HIGH] = low_wmark_pages(zone) + tmp;
6495 zone->_watermark[WMARK_PROMO] = high_wmark_pages(zone) + tmp;
6496 trace_mm_setup_per_zone_wmarks(zone);
6497
6498 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
6499 }
6500
6501 /* update totalreserve_pages */
6502 calculate_totalreserve_pages();
6503}
6504
6512void setup_per_zone_wmarks(void)
6513{
6514 struct zone *zone;
6515 static DEFINE_SPINLOCK(lock);
6516
6517 spin_lock(&lock);
6518 __setup_per_zone_wmarks();
6519 spin_unlock(&lock);
6520
6521 /*
6522 * The watermark size have changed so update the pcpu batch
6523 * and high limits or the limits may be inappropriate.
6524 */
6525 for_each_zone(zone)
6526 zone_pcp_update(zone, 0);
6527}
6528
6529/*
6530 * Initialise min_free_kbytes.
6531 *
6532 * For small machines we want it small (128k min). For large machines
6533 * we want it large (256MB max). But it is not linear, because network
6534 * bandwidth does not increase linearly with machine size. We use
6535 *
6536 * min_free_kbytes = 4 * sqrt(lowmem_kbytes), for better accuracy:
6537 * min_free_kbytes = sqrt(lowmem_kbytes * 16)
6538 *
6539 * which yields
6540 *
6541 * 16MB: 512k
6542 * 32MB: 724k
6543 * 64MB: 1024k
6544 * 128MB: 1448k
6545 * 256MB: 2048k
6546 * 512MB: 2896k
6547 * 1024MB: 4096k
6548 * 2048MB: 5792k
6549 * 4096MB: 8192k
6550 * 8192MB: 11584k
6551 * 16384MB: 16384k
6552 */
6553void calculate_min_free_kbytes(void)
6554{
6555 unsigned long lowmem_kbytes;
6556 int new_min_free_kbytes;
6557
6558 lowmem_kbytes = nr_free_buffer_pages() * (PAGE_SIZE >> 10);
6559 new_min_free_kbytes = int_sqrt(lowmem_kbytes * 16);
6560
6561 if (new_min_free_kbytes > user_min_free_kbytes)
6562 min_free_kbytes = clamp(new_min_free_kbytes, 128, 262144);
6563 else
6564 pr_warn("min_free_kbytes is not updated to %d because user defined value %d is preferred\n",
6565 new_min_free_kbytes, user_min_free_kbytes);
6566
6567}
6568
6569int __meminit init_per_zone_wmark_min(void)
6570{
6571 calculate_min_free_kbytes();
6572 setup_per_zone_wmarks();
6573 refresh_zone_stat_thresholds();
6574 setup_per_zone_lowmem_reserve();
6575
6576#ifdef CONFIG_NUMA
6577 setup_min_unmapped_ratio();
6578 setup_min_slab_ratio();
6579#endif
6580
6581 khugepaged_min_free_kbytes_update();
6582
6583 return 0;
6584}
6585postcore_initcall(init_per_zone_wmark_min)

6587/*
6588 * min_free_kbytes_sysctl_handler - just a wrapper around proc_dointvec() so
6589 * that we can call two helper functions whenever min_free_kbytes
6590 * changes.

6592static int min_free_kbytes_sysctl_handler(const struct ctl_table *table, int write,

6605 return 0;

6681 * lowmem_reserve_ratio_sysctl_handler - just a wrapper around
6682 * proc_dointvec() so that we can call setup_per_zone_lowmem_reserve()
6683 * whenever sysctl_lowmem_reserve_ratio changes.
6684 *
6685 * The reserve ratio obviously has absolutely no relation with the
6686 * minimum watermarks. The lowmem reserve ratio can only make sense
6687 * if in function of the boot time zone sizes.
6688 */
6689static int lowmem_reserve_ratio_sysctl_handler(const struct ctl_table *table,
6690 int write, void *buffer, size_t *length, loff_t *ppos)
6691{
6692 int i;
6693
6694 proc_dointvec_minmax(table, write, buffer, length, ppos);
6695
6696 for (i = 0; i < MAX_NR_ZONES; i++) {
6697 if (sysctl_lowmem_reserve_ratio[i] < 1)
6698 sysctl_lowmem_reserve_ratio[i] = 0;
6699 }
6700
6701 setup_per_zone_lowmem_reserve();
6702 return 0;
6703}

6705/*
6706 * percpu_pagelist_high_fraction - changes the pcp->high for each zone on each
6707 * cpu. It is the fraction of total pages in each zone that a hot per cpu
6708 * pagelist can have before it gets flushed back to buddy allocator.
6709 */
6710static int percpu_pagelist_high_fraction_sysctl_handler(const struct ctl_table *table,
6711 int write, void *buffer, size_t *length, loff_t *ppos)
6712{
6713 struct zone *zone;
6714 int old_percpu_pagelist_high_fraction;
6715 int ret;
6716
6717 /*
6718 * Avoid using pcp_batch_high_lock for reads as the value is read
6719 * atomically and a race with offlining is harmless.
6720 */
6721
6722 if (!write)
6723 return proc_dointvec_minmax(table, write, buffer, length, ppos);
6724
6725 mutex_lock(&pcp_batch_high_lock);
6726 old_percpu_pagelist_high_fraction = percpu_pagelist_high_fraction;
6727
6728 ret = proc_dointvec_minmax(table, write, buffer, length, ppos);
6729 if (ret < 0)
6730 goto out;
6731
6732 /* Sanity checking to avoid pcp imbalance */
6733 if (percpu_pagelist_high_fraction &&
6734 percpu_pagelist_high_fraction < MIN_PERCPU_PAGELIST_HIGH_FRACTION) {
6735 percpu_pagelist_high_fraction = old_percpu_pagelist_high_fraction;
6736 ret = -EINVAL;
6737 goto out;
6738 }
6739
6740 /* No change? */
6741 if (percpu_pagelist_high_fraction == old_percpu_pagelist_high_fraction)
6742 goto out;
6743
6744 for_each_populated_zone(zone)
6745 zone_set_pageset_high_and_batch(zone, 0);
6746out:
6747 mutex_unlock(&pcp_batch_high_lock);
6748 return ret;
6749}

6850/* [start, end) must belong to a single zone. */
6851static int __alloc_contig_migrate_range(struct compact_control *cc,
6852 unsigned long start, unsigned long end)
6853{
6854 /* This function is based on compact_zone() from compaction.c. */
6855 unsigned int nr_reclaimed;
6856 unsigned long pfn = start;
6857 unsigned int tries = 0;
6858 int ret = 0;
6859 struct migration_target_control mtc = {
6860 .nid = zone_to_nid(cc->zone),
6861 .gfp_mask = cc->gfp_mask,
6862 .reason = MR_CONTIG_RANGE,
6863 };
6864
6865 lru_cache_disable();
6866
6867 while (pfn < end || !list_empty(&cc->migratepages)) {
6868 if (fatal_signal_pending(current)) {
6869 ret = -EINTR;
6870 break;
6871 }
6872
6873 if (list_empty(&cc->migratepages)) {
6874 cc->nr_migratepages = 0;
6875 ret = isolate_migratepages_range(cc, pfn, end);
6876 if (ret && ret != -EAGAIN)
6877 break;
6878 pfn = cc->migrate_pfn;
6879 tries = 0;
6880 } else if (++tries == 5) {
6881 ret = -EBUSY;
6882 break;
6883 }
6884
6885 nr_reclaimed = reclaim_clean_pages_from_list(cc->zone,
6886 &cc->migratepages);
6887 cc->nr_migratepages -= nr_reclaimed;
6888
6889 ret = migrate_pages(&cc->migratepages, alloc_migration_target,
6890 NULL, (unsigned long)&mtc, cc->mode, MR_CONTIG_RANGE, NULL);
6891
6892 /*
6893 * On -ENOMEM, migrate_pages() bails out right away. It is pointless
6894 * to retry again over this error, so do the same here.
6895 */
6896 if (ret == -ENOMEM)
6897 break;
6898 }
6899
6900 lru_cache_enable();
6901 if (ret < 0) {
6902 if (!(cc->gfp_mask & __GFP_NOWARN) && ret == -EBUSY)
6903 alloc_contig_dump_pages(&cc->migratepages);
6904 putback_movable_pages(&cc->migratepages);
6905 }
6906
6907 return (ret < 0) ? ret : 0;
6908}
6909
6910static void split_free_frozen_pages(struct list_head *list, gfp_t gfp_mask)
6911{
6912 int order;
6913
6914 for (order = 0; order < NR_PAGE_ORDERS; order++) {
6915 struct page *page, *next;
6916 int nr_pages = 1 << order;
6917
6918 list_for_each_entry_safe(page, next, &list[order], lru) {
6919 int i;
6920
6921 post_alloc_hook(page, order, gfp_mask);
6922 if (!order)
6923 continue;
6924
6925 __split_page(page, order);
6926
6927 /* Add all subpages to the order-0 head, in sequence. */
6928 list_del(&page->lru);
6929 for (i = 0; i < nr_pages; i++)
6930 list_add_tail(&page[i].lru, &list[0]);
6931 }
6932 }
6933}
6934
6935static int __alloc_contig_verify_gfp_mask(gfp_t gfp_mask, gfp_t *gfp_cc_mask)
6936{
6937 const gfp_t reclaim_mask = __GFP_IO | __GFP_FS | __GFP_RECLAIM;
6938 const gfp_t action_mask = __GFP_COMP | __GFP_RETRY_MAYFAIL | __GFP_NOWARN |
6939 __GFP_ZERO | __GFP_ZEROTAGS | __GFP_SKIP_ZERO |
6940 __GFP_SKIP_KASAN;
6941 const gfp_t cc_action_mask = __GFP_RETRY_MAYFAIL | __GFP_NOWARN;
6942
6943 /*
6944 * We are given the range to allocate; node, mobility and placement
6945 * hints are irrelevant at this point. We'll simply ignore them.
6946 */
6947 gfp_mask &= ~(GFP_ZONEMASK | __GFP_RECLAIMABLE | __GFP_WRITE |
6948 __GFP_HARDWALL | __GFP_THISNODE | __GFP_MOVABLE);
6949
6950 /*
6951 * We only support most reclaim flags (but not NOFAIL/NORETRY), and
6952 * selected action flags.
6953 */
6954 if (gfp_mask & ~(reclaim_mask | action_mask))
6955 return -EINVAL;
6956
6957 /*
6958 * Flags to control page compaction/migration/reclaim, to free up our
6959 * page range. Migratable pages are movable, __GFP_MOVABLE is implied
6960 * for them.
6961 *
6962 * Traditionally we always had __GFP_RETRY_MAYFAIL set, keep doing that
6963 * to not degrade callers.
6964 */
6965 *gfp_cc_mask = (gfp_mask & (reclaim_mask | cc_action_mask)) |
6966 __GFP_MOVABLE | __GFP_RETRY_MAYFAIL;
6967 return 0;
6968}
6969
6970static void __free_contig_frozen_range(unsigned long pfn, unsigned long nr_pages)
6971{
6972 for (; nr_pages--; pfn++)
6973 free_frozen_pages(pfn_to_page(pfn), 0);
6974}
6975
6999int alloc_contig_frozen_range_noprof(unsigned long start, unsigned long end,
7000 acr_flags_t alloc_flags, gfp_t gfp_mask)
7001{
7002 const unsigned int order = ilog2(end - start);
7003 unsigned long outer_start, outer_end;
7004 int ret = 0;
7005
7006 struct compact_control cc = {
7007 .nr_migratepages = 0,
7008 .order = -1,
7009 .zone = page_zone(pfn_to_page(start)),
7010 .mode = MIGRATE_SYNC,
7011 .ignore_skip_hint = true,
7012 .no_set_skip_hint = true,
7013 .alloc_contig = true,
7014 };
7015 INIT_LIST_HEAD(&cc.migratepages);
7016 enum pb_isolate_mode mode = (alloc_flags & ACR_FLAGS_CMA) ?
7017 PB_ISOLATE_MODE_CMA_ALLOC :
7018 PB_ISOLATE_MODE_OTHER;
7019
7020 /*
7021 * In contrast to the buddy, we allow for orders here that exceed
7022 * MAX_PAGE_ORDER, so we must manually make sure that we are not
7023 * exceeding the maximum folio order.
7024 */
7025 if (WARN_ON_ONCE((gfp_mask & __GFP_COMP) && order > MAX_FOLIO_ORDER))
7026 return -EINVAL;
7027
7028 gfp_mask = current_gfp_context(gfp_mask);
7029 if (__alloc_contig_verify_gfp_mask(gfp_mask, (gfp_t *)&cc.gfp_mask))
7030 return -EINVAL;
7031
7032 /*
7033 * What we do here is we mark all pageblocks in range as
7034 * MIGRATE_ISOLATE. Because pageblock and max order pages may
7035 * have different sizes, and due to the way page allocator
7036 * work, start_isolate_page_range() has special handlings for this.
7037 *
7038 * Once the pageblocks are marked as MIGRATE_ISOLATE, we
7039 * migrate the pages from an unaligned range (ie. pages that
7040 * we are interested in). This will put all the pages in
7041 * range back to page allocator as MIGRATE_ISOLATE.
7042 *
7043 * When this is done, we take the pages in range from page
7044 * allocator removing them from the buddy system. This way
7045 * page allocator will never consider using them.
7046 *
7047 * This lets us mark the pageblocks back as
7048 * MIGRATE_CMA/MIGRATE_MOVABLE so that free pages in the
7049 * aligned range but not in the unaligned, original range are
7050 * put back to page allocator so that buddy can use them.
7051 */
7052
7053 ret = start_isolate_page_range(start, end, mode);
7054 if (ret)
7055 goto done;
7056
7057 drain_all_pages(cc.zone);
7058
7059 /*
7060 * In case of -EBUSY, we'd like to know which page causes problem.
7061 * So, just fall through. test_pages_isolated() has a tracepoint
7062 * which will report the busy page.
7063 *
7064 * It is possible that busy pages could become available before
7065 * the call to test_pages_isolated, and the range will actually be
7066 * allocated. So, if we fall through be sure to clear ret so that
7067 * -EBUSY is not accidentally used or returned to caller.
7068 */
7069 ret = __alloc_contig_migrate_range(&cc, start, end);
7070 if (ret && ret != -EBUSY)
7071 goto done;
7072
7073 /*
7074 * When in-use hugetlb pages are migrated, they may simply be released
7075 * back into the free hugepage pool instead of being returned to the
7076 * buddy system. After the migration of in-use huge pages is completed,
7077 * we will invoke replace_free_hugepage_folios() to ensure that these
7078 * hugepages are properly released to the buddy system.
7079 */
7080 ret = replace_free_hugepage_folios(start, end);
7081 if (ret)
7082 goto done;
7083
7084 /*
7085 * Pages from [start, end) are within a pageblock_nr_pages
7086 * aligned blocks that are marked as MIGRATE_ISOLATE. What's
7087 * more, all pages in [start, end) are free in page allocator.
7088 * What we are going to do is to allocate all pages from
7089 * [start, end) (that is remove them from page allocator).
7090 *
7091 * The only problem is that pages at the beginning and at the
7092 * end of interesting range may be not aligned with pages that
7093 * page allocator holds, ie. they can be part of higher order
7094 * pages. Because of this, we reserve the bigger range and
7095 * once this is done free the pages we are not interested in.
7096 *
7097 * We don't have to hold zone->lock here because the pages are
7098 * isolated thus they won't get removed from buddy.
7099 */
7100 outer_start = find_large_buddy(start);
7101
7102 /* Make sure the range is really isolated. */
7103 if (test_pages_isolated(outer_start, end, mode)) {
7104 ret = -EBUSY;
7105 goto done;
7106 }
7107
7108 /* Grab isolated pages from freelists. */
7109 outer_end = isolate_freepages_range(&cc, outer_start, end);
7110 if (!outer_end) {
7111 ret = -EBUSY;
7112 goto done;
7113 }
7114
7115 if (!(gfp_mask & __GFP_COMP)) {
7116 split_free_frozen_pages(cc.freepages, gfp_mask);
7117
7118 /* Free head and tail (if any) */
7119 if (start != outer_start)
7120 __free_contig_frozen_range(outer_start, start - outer_start);
7121 if (end != outer_end)
7122 __free_contig_frozen_range(end, outer_end - end);
7123 } else if (start == outer_start && end == outer_end && is_power_of_2(end - start)) {
7124 struct page *head = pfn_to_page(start);
7125
7126 check_new_pages(head, order);
7127 prep_new_page(head, order, gfp_mask, 0);
7128 } else {
7129 ret = -EINVAL;
7130 WARN(true, "PFN range: requested [%lu, %lu), allocated [%lu, %lu)\n",
7131 start, end, outer_start, outer_end);
7132 }
7133done:
7134 undo_isolate_page_range(start, end);
7135 return ret;
7136}
7137EXPORT_SYMBOL(alloc_contig_frozen_range_noprof);
7138
7156int alloc_contig_range_noprof(unsigned long start, unsigned long end,
7157 acr_flags_t alloc_flags, gfp_t gfp_mask)
7158{
7159 int ret;
7160
7161 if (WARN_ON(gfp_mask & __GFP_COMP))
7162 return -EINVAL;
7163
7164 ret = alloc_contig_frozen_range_noprof(start, end, alloc_flags, gfp_mask);
7165 if (!ret)
7166 set_pages_refcounted(pfn_to_page(start), end - start);
7167
7168 return ret;
7169}
7170EXPORT_SYMBOL(alloc_contig_range_noprof);

7172static bool pfn_range_valid_contig(struct zone *z, unsigned long start_pfn,
7173 unsigned long nr_pages, bool skip_hugetlb,
7174 bool *skipped_hugetlb)
7175{
7176 unsigned long end_pfn = start_pfn + nr_pages;
7177 struct page *page;
7178
7179 while (start_pfn < end_pfn) {
7180 unsigned long step = 1;
7181
7182 page = pfn_to_online_page(start_pfn);
7183 if (!page)
7184 return false;
7185
7186 if (page_zone(page) != z)
7187 return false;
7188
7189 if (page_is_unmovable(z, page, PB_ISOLATE_MODE_OTHER, &step))
7190 return false;
7191
7192 /*
7193 * Only consider ranges containing hugepages if those pages are
7194 * smaller than the requested contiguous region. e.g.:
7195 * Move 2MB pages to free up a 1GB range.
7196 * Don't move 1GB pages to free up a 2MB range.
7197 *
7198 * This makes contiguous allocation more reliable if multiple
7199 * hugepage sizes are used without causing needless movement.
7200 */
7201 if (PageHuge(page)) {
7202 unsigned int order;
7203
7204 if (skip_hugetlb) {
7205 *skipped_hugetlb = true;
7206 return false;
7207 }
7208
7209 page = compound_head(page);
7210 order = compound_order(page);
7211 if ((order >= MAX_FOLIO_ORDER) ||
7212 (nr_pages <= (1 << order)))
7213 return false;
7214 }
7215
7216 start_pfn += step;
7217 }
7218 return true;
7219}
7220
7221static bool zone_spans_last_pfn(const struct zone *zone,
7222 unsigned long start_pfn, unsigned long nr_pages)
7223{
7224 unsigned long last_pfn = start_pfn + nr_pages - 1;
7225
7226 return zone_spans_pfn(zone, last_pfn);
7227}
7228
7255struct page *alloc_contig_frozen_pages_noprof(unsigned long nr_pages,
7256 gfp_t gfp_mask, int nid, nodemask_t *nodemask)
7257{
7258 unsigned long ret, pfn, flags;
7259 struct zonelist *zonelist;
7260 struct zone *zone;
7261 struct zoneref *z;
7262 bool skip_hugetlb = true;
7263 bool skipped_hugetlb = false;
7264
7265retry:
7266 zonelist = node_zonelist(nid, gfp_mask);
7267 for_each_zone_zonelist_nodemask(zone, z, zonelist,
7268 gfp_zone(gfp_mask), nodemask) {
7269 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
7270
7271 pfn = ALIGN(zone->zone_start_pfn, nr_pages);
7272 while (zone_spans_last_pfn(zone, pfn, nr_pages)) {
7273 if (pfn_range_valid_contig(zone, pfn, nr_pages,
7274 skip_hugetlb,
7275 &skipped_hugetlb)) {
7276 /*
7277 * We release the zone lock here because
7278 * alloc_contig_frozen_range() will also lock
7279 * the zone at some point. If there's an
7280 * allocation spinning on this lock, it may
7281 * win the race and cause allocation to fail.
7282 */
7283 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
7284 ret = alloc_contig_frozen_range_noprof(pfn,
7285 pfn + nr_pages,
7286 ACR_FLAGS_NONE,
7287 gfp_mask);
7288 if (!ret)
7289 return pfn_to_page(pfn);
7290 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
7291 }
7292 pfn += nr_pages;
7293 }
7294 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
7295 }
7296 /*
7297 * If we failed, retry the search, but treat regions with HugeTLB pages
7298 * as valid targets. This retains fast-allocations on first pass
7299 * without trying to migrate HugeTLB pages (which may fail). On the
7300 * second pass, we will try moving HugeTLB pages when those pages are
7301 * smaller than the requested contiguous region size.
7302 */
7303 if (skip_hugetlb && skipped_hugetlb) {
7304 skip_hugetlb = false;
7305 goto retry;
7306 }
7307 return NULL;
7308}
7309EXPORT_SYMBOL(alloc_contig_frozen_pages_noprof);
7310
7327struct page *alloc_contig_pages_noprof(unsigned long nr_pages, gfp_t gfp_mask,
7328 int nid, nodemask_t *nodemask)
7329{
7330 struct page *page;
7331
7332 if (WARN_ON(gfp_mask & __GFP_COMP))
7333 return NULL;
7334
7335 page = alloc_contig_frozen_pages_noprof(nr_pages, gfp_mask, nid,
7336 nodemask);
7337 if (page)
7338 set_pages_refcounted(page, nr_pages);
7339
7340 return page;
7341}
7342EXPORT_SYMBOL(alloc_contig_pages_noprof);
7343
7351void free_contig_frozen_range(unsigned long pfn, unsigned long nr_pages)
7352{
7353 struct page *first_page = pfn_to_page(pfn);
7354 const unsigned int order = ilog2(nr_pages);
7355
7356 if (WARN_ON_ONCE(first_page != compound_head(first_page)))
7357 return;
7358
7359 if (PageHead(first_page)) {
7360 WARN_ON_ONCE(order != compound_order(first_page));
7361 free_frozen_pages(first_page, order);
7362 return;
7363 }
7364
7365 __free_contig_frozen_range(pfn, nr_pages);
7366}
7367EXPORT_SYMBOL(free_contig_frozen_range);
