7387/*
7388 * Effectively disable pcplists for the zone by setting the high limit to 0
7389 * and draining all cpus. A concurrent page freeing on another CPU that's about
7390 * to put the page on pcplist will either finish before the drain and the page
7391 * will be drained, or observe the new high limit and skip the pcplist.
7392 *
7393 * Must be paired with a call to zone_pcp_enable().
7394 */
7395void zone_pcp_disable(struct zone *zone)
7396{
7397 mutex_lock(&pcp_batch_high_lock);
7398 __zone_set_pageset_high_and_batch(zone, 0, 0, 1);
7399 __drain_all_pages(zone, true);
7400}
7401
7402void zone_pcp_enable(struct zone *zone)
7403{
7404 __zone_set_pageset_high_and_batch(zone, zone->pageset_high_min,
7405 zone->pageset_high_max, zone->pageset_batch);
7406 mutex_unlock(&pcp_batch_high_lock);
7407}
7408
7409void zone_pcp_reset(struct zone *zone)
7410{
7411 int cpu;
7412 struct per_cpu_zonestat *pzstats;
7413
7414 if (zone->per_cpu_pageset != &boot_pageset) {
7415 for_each_online_cpu(cpu) {
7416 pzstats = per_cpu_ptr(zone->per_cpu_zonestats, cpu);
7417 drain_zonestat(zone, pzstats);
7418 }
7419 free_percpu(zone->per_cpu_pageset);
7420 zone->per_cpu_pageset = &boot_pageset;
7421 if (zone->per_cpu_zonestats != &boot_zonestats) {
7422 free_percpu(zone->per_cpu_zonestats);
7423 zone->per_cpu_zonestats = &boot_zonestats;
7424 }
7425 }
7426}

7428#ifdef CONFIG_MEMORY_HOTREMOVE
7429/*
7430 * All pages in the range must be in a single zone, must not contain holes,
7431 * must span full sections, and must be isolated before calling this function.
7432 *
7433 * Returns the number of managed (non-PageOffline()) pages in the range: the
7434 * number of pages for which memory offlining code must adjust managed page
7435 * counters using adjust_managed_page_count().
7436 */
7437unsigned long __offline_isolated_pages(unsigned long start_pfn,
7438 unsigned long end_pfn)
7439{
7440 unsigned long already_offline = 0, flags;
7441 unsigned long pfn = start_pfn;
7442 struct page *page;
7443 struct zone *zone;
7444 unsigned int order;
7445
7446 offline_mem_sections(pfn, end_pfn);
7447 zone = page_zone(pfn_to_page(pfn));
7448 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
7449 while (pfn < end_pfn) {
7450 page = pfn_to_page(pfn);
7451 /*
7452 * The HWPoisoned page may be not in buddy system, and
7453 * page_count() is not 0.
7454 */
7455 if (unlikely(!PageBuddy(page) && PageHWPoison(page))) {
7456 pfn++;
7457 continue;
7458 }
7459 /*
7460 * At this point all remaining PageOffline() pages have a
7461 * reference count of 0 and can simply be skipped.
7462 */
7463 if (PageOffline(page)) {
7464 BUG_ON(page_count(page));
7465 BUG_ON(PageBuddy(page));
7466 already_offline++;
7467 pfn++;
7468 continue;
7469 }
7470
7471 BUG_ON(page_count(page));
7472 BUG_ON(!PageBuddy(page));
7473 VM_WARN_ON(get_pageblock_migratetype(page) != MIGRATE_ISOLATE);
7474 order = buddy_order(page);
7475 del_page_from_free_list(page, zone, order, MIGRATE_ISOLATE);
7476 pfn += (1 << order);
7477 }
7478 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
7479
7480 return end_pfn - start_pfn - already_offline;
7481}
7482#endif
7483
7484/*
7485 * This function returns a stable result only if called under zone lock.
7486 */
7487bool is_free_buddy_page(const struct page *page)
7488{
7489 unsigned long pfn = page_to_pfn(page);
7490 unsigned int order;
7491
7492 for (order = 0; order < NR_PAGE_ORDERS; order++) {
7493 const struct page *head = page - (pfn & ((1 << order) - 1));
7494
7495 if (PageBuddy(head) &&
7496 buddy_order_unsafe(head) >= order)
7497 break;
7498 }
7499
7500 return order <= MAX_PAGE_ORDER;
7501}
7502EXPORT_SYMBOL(is_free_buddy_page);

7504#ifdef CONFIG_MEMORY_FAILURE
7505static inline void add_to_free_list(struct page *page, struct zone *zone,
7506 unsigned int order, int migratetype,
7507 bool tail)
7508{
7509 __add_to_free_list(page, zone, order, migratetype, tail);
7510 account_freepages(zone, 1 << order, migratetype);
7511}

7513/*
7514 * Break down a higher-order page in sub-pages, and keep our target out of
7515 * buddy allocator.
7516 */
7517static void break_down_buddy_pages(struct zone *zone, struct page *page,
7518 struct page *target, int low, int high,
7519 int migratetype)
7520{
7521 unsigned long size = 1 << high;
7522 struct page *current_buddy;
7523
7524 while (high > low) {
7525 high--;
7526 size >>= 1;
7527
7528 if (target >= &page[size]) {
7529 current_buddy = page;
7530 page = page + size;
7531 } else {
7532 current_buddy = page + size;
7533 }
7534
7535 if (set_page_guard(zone, current_buddy, high))
7536 continue;
7537
7538 add_to_free_list(current_buddy, zone, high, migratetype, false);
7539 set_buddy_order(current_buddy, high);
7540 }
7541}
7542
7543/*
7544 * Take a page that will be marked as poisoned off the buddy allocator.
7545 */
7546bool take_page_off_buddy(struct page *page)
7547{
7548 struct zone *zone = page_zone(page);
7549 unsigned long pfn = page_to_pfn(page);
7550 unsigned long flags;
7551 unsigned int order;
7552 bool ret = false;
7553
7554 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
7555 for (order = 0; order < NR_PAGE_ORDERS; order++) {
7556 struct page *page_head = page - (pfn & ((1 << order) - 1));
7557 int page_order = buddy_order(page_head);
7558
7559 if (PageBuddy(page_head) && page_order >= order) {
7560 unsigned long pfn_head = page_to_pfn(page_head);
7561 int migratetype = get_pfnblock_migratetype(page_head,
7562 pfn_head);
7563
7564 del_page_from_free_list(page_head, zone, page_order,
7565 migratetype);
7566 break_down_buddy_pages(zone, page_head, page, 0,
7567 page_order, migratetype);
7568 SetPageHWPoisonTakenOff(page);
7569 ret = true;
7570 break;
7571 }
7572 if (page_count(page_head) > 0)
7573 break;
7574 }
7575 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
7576 return ret;
7577}
7578
7579/*
7580 * Cancel takeoff done by take_page_off_buddy().
7581 */
7582bool put_page_back_buddy(struct page *page)
7583{
7584 struct zone *zone = page_zone(page);
7585 unsigned long flags;
7586 bool ret = false;
7587
7588 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
7589 if (put_page_testzero(page)) {
7590 unsigned long pfn = page_to_pfn(page);
7591 int migratetype = get_pfnblock_migratetype(page, pfn);
7592
7593 ClearPageHWPoisonTakenOff(page);
7594 __free_one_page(page, pfn, zone, 0, migratetype, FPI_NONE);
7595 if (TestClearPageHWPoison(page)) {
7596 ret = true;
7597 }
7598 }
7599 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
7600
7601 return ret;
7602}
7603#endif
7604
7605bool has_managed_zone(enum zone_type zone)
7606{
7607 struct pglist_data *pgdat;
7608
7609 for_each_online_pgdat(pgdat) {
7610 if (managed_zone(&pgdat->node_zones[zone]))
7611 return true;
7612 }
7613 return false;
7614}

7618static bool lazy_accept = true;
7619
7620static int __init accept_memory_parse(char *p)
7621{
7622 if (!strcmp(p, "lazy")) {
7623 lazy_accept = true;
7624 return 0;
7625 } else if (!strcmp(p, "eager")) {
7626 lazy_accept = false;
7627 return 0;
7628 } else {
7629 return -EINVAL;
7630 }
7631}
7632early_param("accept_memory", accept_memory_parse);

7634static bool page_contains_unaccepted(struct page *page, unsigned int order)
7635{
7636 phys_addr_t start = page_to_phys(page);
7637
7638 return range_contains_unaccepted_memory(start, PAGE_SIZE << order);
7639}
7640
7641static void __accept_page(struct zone *zone, unsigned long *flags,
7642 struct page *page)
7643{
7644 list_del(&page->lru);
7645 account_freepages(zone, -MAX_ORDER_NR_PAGES, MIGRATE_MOVABLE);
7646 __mod_zone_page_state(zone, NR_UNACCEPTED, -MAX_ORDER_NR_PAGES);
7647 __ClearPageUnaccepted(page);
7648 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, *flags);
7649
7650 accept_memory(page_to_phys(page), PAGE_SIZE << MAX_PAGE_ORDER);
7651
7652 __free_pages_ok(page, MAX_PAGE_ORDER, FPI_TO_TAIL);
7653}
7654
7655void accept_page(struct page *page)
7656{
7657 struct zone *zone = page_zone(page);
7658 unsigned long flags;
7659
7660 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
7661 if (!PageUnaccepted(page)) {
7662 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
7663 return;
7664 }
7665
7666 /* Unlocks zone->lock */
7667 __accept_page(zone, &flags, page);
7668}
7669
7670static bool try_to_accept_memory_one(struct zone *zone)
7671{
7672 unsigned long flags;
7673 struct page *page;
7674
7675 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
7676 page = list_first_entry_or_null(&zone->unaccepted_pages,
7677 struct page, lru);
7678 if (!page) {
7679 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
7680 return false;
7681 }
7682
7683 /* Unlocks zone->lock */
7684 __accept_page(zone, &flags, page);
7685
7686 return true;
7687}
7688
7689static bool cond_accept_memory(struct zone *zone, unsigned int order,
7690 int alloc_flags)
7691{
7692 long to_accept, wmark;
7693 bool ret = false;
7694
7695 if (list_empty(&zone->unaccepted_pages))
7696 return false;
7697
7698 /* Bailout, since try_to_accept_memory_one() needs to take a lock */
7699 if (alloc_flags & ALLOC_TRYLOCK)
7700 return false;
7701
7702 wmark = promo_wmark_pages(zone);
7703
7704 /*
7705 * Watermarks have not been initialized yet.
7706 *
7707 * Accepting one MAX_ORDER page to ensure progress.
7708 */
7709 if (!wmark)
7710 return try_to_accept_memory_one(zone);
7711
7712 /* How much to accept to get to promo watermark? */
7713 to_accept = wmark -
7714 (zone_page_state(zone, NR_FREE_PAGES) -
7715 __zone_watermark_unusable_free(zone, order, 0) -
7716 zone_page_state(zone, NR_UNACCEPTED));
7717
7718 while (to_accept > 0) {
7719 if (!try_to_accept_memory_one(zone))
7720 break;
7721 ret = true;
7722 to_accept -= MAX_ORDER_NR_PAGES;
7723 }
7724
7725 return ret;
7726}
7727
7728static bool __free_unaccepted(struct page *page)
7729{
7730 struct zone *zone = page_zone(page);
7731 unsigned long flags;
7732
7733 if (!lazy_accept)
7734 return false;
7735
7736 spin_lock_irqsave(&zone->lock, flags);
7737 list_add_tail(&page->lru, &zone->unaccepted_pages);
7738 account_freepages(zone, MAX_ORDER_NR_PAGES, MIGRATE_MOVABLE);
7739 __mod_zone_page_state(zone, NR_UNACCEPTED, MAX_ORDER_NR_PAGES);
7740 __SetPageUnaccepted(page);
7741 spin_unlock_irqrestore(&zone->lock, flags);
7742
7743 return true;
7744}
7745
7746#else
7747
7748static bool page_contains_unaccepted(struct page *page, unsigned int order)
7749{
7750 return false;
7751}
7752
7753static bool cond_accept_memory(struct zone *zone, unsigned int order,
7754 int alloc_flags)
7755{
7756 return false;
7757}
7758
7759static bool __free_unaccepted(struct page *page)
7760{
7761 BUILD_BUG();
7762 return false;
7763}

7766
7767struct page *alloc_frozen_pages_nolock_noprof(gfp_t gfp_flags, int nid, unsigned int order)
7768{
7769 /*
7770 * Do not specify __GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM, since direct claim is not allowed.
7771 * Do not specify __GFP_KSWAPD_RECLAIM either, since wake up of kswapd
7772 * is not safe in arbitrary context.
7773 *
7774 * These two are the conditions for gfpflags_allow_spinning() being true.
7775 *
7776 * Specify __GFP_NOWARN since failing alloc_pages_nolock() is not a reason
7777 * to warn. Also warn would trigger printk() which is unsafe from
7778 * various contexts. We cannot use printk_deferred_enter() to mitigate,
7779 * since the running context is unknown.
7780 *
7781 * Specify __GFP_ZERO to make sure that call to kmsan_alloc_page() below
7782 * is safe in any context. Also zeroing the page is mandatory for
7783 * BPF use cases.
7784 *
7785 * Though __GFP_NOMEMALLOC is not checked in the code path below,
7786 * specify it here to highlight that alloc_pages_nolock()
7787 * doesn't want to deplete reserves.
7788 */
7789 gfp_t alloc_gfp = __GFP_NOWARN | __GFP_ZERO | __GFP_NOMEMALLOC | __GFP_COMP
7790 | gfp_flags;
7791 unsigned int alloc_flags = ALLOC_TRYLOCK;
7792 struct alloc_context ac = { };
7793 struct page *page;
7794
7795 VM_WARN_ON_ONCE(gfp_flags & ~__GFP_ACCOUNT);
7796 /*
7797 * In PREEMPT_RT spin_trylock() will call raw_spin_lock() which is
7798 * unsafe in NMI. If spin_trylock() is called from hard IRQ the current
7799 * task may be waiting for one rt_spin_lock, but rt_spin_trylock() will
7800 * mark the task as the owner of another rt_spin_lock which will
7801 * confuse PI logic, so return immediately if called from hard IRQ or
7802 * NMI.
7803 *
7804 * Note, irqs_disabled() case is ok. This function can be called
7805 * from raw_spin_lock_irqsave region.
7806 */
7807 if (IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_PREEMPT_RT) && (in_nmi() || in_hardirq()))
7808 return NULL;
7809
7810 /* On UP, spin_trylock() always succeeds even when it is locked */
7811 if (!IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_SMP) && in_nmi())
7812 return NULL;
7813
7814 if (!pcp_allowed_order(order))
7815 return NULL;
7816
7817 /* Bailout, since _deferred_grow_zone() needs to take a lock */
7818 if (deferred_pages_enabled())
7819 return NULL;
7820
7821 if (nid == NUMA_NO_NODE)
7822 nid = numa_node_id();
7823
7824 prepare_alloc_pages(alloc_gfp, order, nid, NULL, &ac,
7825 &alloc_gfp, &alloc_flags);
7826
7827 /*
7828 * Best effort allocation from percpu free list.
7829 * If it's empty attempt to spin_trylock zone->lock.
7830 */
7831 page = get_page_from_freelist(alloc_gfp, order, alloc_flags, &ac);
7832
7833 /* Unlike regular alloc_pages() there is no __alloc_pages_slowpath(). */
7834
7835 if (memcg_kmem_online() && page && (gfp_flags & __GFP_ACCOUNT) &&
7836 unlikely(__memcg_kmem_charge_page(page, alloc_gfp, order) != 0)) {
7837 __free_frozen_pages(page, order, FPI_TRYLOCK);
7838 page = NULL;
7839 }
7840 trace_mm_page_alloc(page, order, alloc_gfp, ac.migratetype);
7841 kmsan_alloc_page(page, order, alloc_gfp);
7842 return page;
7843}
7844
7860struct page *alloc_pages_nolock_noprof(gfp_t gfp_flags, int nid, unsigned int order)
7861{
7862 struct page *page;
7863
7864 page = alloc_frozen_pages_nolock_noprof(gfp_flags, nid, order);
7865 if (page)
7866 set_page_refcounted(page);
7867 return page;
7868}
7869EXPORT_SYMBOL_GPL(alloc_pages_nolock_noprof);
